inequality.sentenceEn: Residents of the San Francisco Bay Area strongly resent the tech industry because of the economic inequality it has contributed to.

inequality.sentenceEn: Socioeconomic inequality is likely to persist.
inequality.translationZh: 社会经济不平等可能会持续存在。

insurance.sentenceEn: "The health insurance company Blue Cross wants me to put you out in the snow tomorrow afternoon," he tells me after I have been in the hospital for more than a week.
insurance.translationZh: 我住院已一周有余，他对我说：‘蓝十字健康保险公司想让我明天下午就把你打发出院，扔到雪地里去。’
insurance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

insurance.sentenceEn: Driven by faster internet connections, ubiquitous(无处不在的) smartphones and changing insurance standards, more health providers are turning to electronic communications to do their jobs—and it's dramatically changing the delivery of healthcare.
insurance.translationZh: 在更快的互联网连接、无处不在的智能手机以及不断变化的保险标准推动下，越来越多的医疗服务提供者开始借助电子通信方式开展工作——这正极大地改变着医疗服务的提供方式。

insurance.sentenceEn: And there's the question of what services physicians should be paid for: Insurance coverage varies from health plan to health plan, and a big federal plan covers only a narrow range of services.
insurance.translationZh: 此外还有一个问题：医生应该为哪些服务获得报酬？保险覆盖范围因健康计划而异，而一项重要的联邦计划仅涵盖范围有限的服务。

insurance.sentenceEn: The first, as you may predict, is for selfish gain, such as submitting a fraudulent claim to an insurance company, while the second involves lying to help others or not offend others, for example, telling a friend whose outfit you don't like that they look great.
insurance.translationZh: 第一种，正如你可能猜到的，是出于自私的利益，比如向保险公司提交欺诈性索赔；第二种则是为了帮助他人或不冒犯他人而撒谎，例如，当朋友穿了你不喜欢的衣服时，你却说他们看起来很棒。
insurance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

insurance.sentenceEn: What life insurance should a single person buy according to the speaker?
insurance.translationZh: 根据讲话者的观点，单身人士应该购买什么样的人寿保险？

insurance.sentenceEn: Talk to the manager of Safe House Insurance .

ignore.sentenceEn: Take a close look next time you're in Boston, and here are some of the things you'll probably see: people smoking in the subway stations despite the frequent reminders not to do so; pedestrians walking when the crosswalk lights say not to do so, ignoring the cars; car drivers speeding, making a loud noise with the horn and occasionally cursing at each other.
ignore.translationZh: 下次你在波士顿时仔细观察，可能会发现这些现象：人们无视频繁的警示在地铁站吸烟；行人不顾交通信号灯和车辆，闯红灯过马路；汽车司机超速行驶，按喇叭制造噪音，偶尔还会互相咒骂。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

ignore.sentenceEn: However, when they looked at transportation's carbon footprint, they ignored impacts on the climate from manufacturing vehicle materials and parts, assembling vehicles and maintaining roads, bridges and airports.
ignore.translationZh: 然而，在考察交通运输的碳足迹时，他们忽略了制造车辆材料和零部件、组装车辆以及维护道路、桥梁和机场对气候的影响。

ignore.sentenceEn: A third version involved the participants' partner alternating between periods of interaction with their phone and periods where they ignored their phone.
ignore.translationZh: 第三种版本涉及参与者的伴侣在玩手机与不玩手机之间交替进行。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

ignore.sentenceEn: You've probably been with someone who ignored you while interacting with his or her smartphone.
ignore.translationZh: 你可能遇到过这种情况：当你和某人在一起时，对方却只顾着玩手机而冷落了你。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ignore.sentenceEn: Even though a green light signals "go", attention should be paid to traffic on either side in case some driver is being careless or ignoring a red light.
ignore.translationZh: 虽然绿灯代表“通行”，但仍应注意两侧交通，以防有司机粗心大意或闯红灯。

ignore.sentenceEn: They are matters the American government typically ignores when formulating educational policies.
ignore.translationZh: 这些都是美国政府在制定教育政策时通常会忽视的问题。

indicate.sentenceEn: However, this study does indicate that, if you have not been active, you can still benefit if you start becoming active in your 40s and 50s.
indicate.translationZh: 然而，这项研究确实表明，即使你以前一直不怎么运动，但如果从四五十岁开始变得活跃起来，依然能从中获益。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

indicate.sentenceEn: A 2020 report by Citi indicated that "Black students could have increased their lifetime incomes $90 – $113 billion" if equity issues related to higher education had been adequately addressed over the past two decades.
indicate.translationZh: 花旗银行 2020 年的一份报告指出，如果过去二十年里与高等教育相关的公平问题能够得到妥善解决，“黑人学生的终身收入本可以增加 900 亿至 1130 亿美元”。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

indicate.sentenceEn: Research indicates that people link their self-identity and social status to their commitments.
indicate.translationZh: 研究表明，人们会将自己的自我认同和社会地位与他们所承担的承诺联系起来。

indicate.sentenceEn: In most states and cities, you can take a right on red unless otherwise indicated .
indicate.translationZh: 在大多数州和城市，除非另有说明，红灯时可以右转。

indicate.sentenceEn: Research conducted on artists and scientists indicates that creative people are less interested in hanging out with others.

indicate.sentenceEn: Indicate the competitiveness of their products.

invest.sentenceEn: Invest time in your work instead.
invest.translationZh: 把时间花在你的工作上吧。

invest.translationZh: 在人际关系上投入时间？
invest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第7句

invest.sentenceEn: We realize that we can't get back the resources we've given, so we persevere — investing in a project that should be halted, staying in a relationship that should be over, or finishing a book we no longer enjoy and should put down, because we're already halfway through it.
invest.translationZh: 我们意识到无法收回已经投入的资源，于是选择坚持下去——即便是一个本该停止的项目也继续投资，一段本该结束的关系也苦苦维持，或者一本已经读不下去且本该放下的书，只因为已经读了一半就非要把它读完。

invest.sentenceEn: We are all susceptible to the sunk-cost delusion, an unconscious bias that leads us to persist in an endeavor we have already invested time, effort, or money into — even when abandoning it would be more beneficial.
invest.translationZh: 我们都容易受到沉没成本谬误的影响。这是一种无意识的偏见，促使我们坚持投入了时间、精力或金钱的事业——即便放弃它会更有利。

invest.sentenceEn: But there's also work suggesting that children sometimes invest less mental effort in learning from electronic books, and that parents talk less about content when sharing such books.
invest.translationZh: 但也有研究表明，孩子们在阅读电子书时投入的学习精力有时较少，而父母在分享此类书籍时，对内容的讨论也相对较少。
invest.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

invest.sentenceEn: She invested in several private companies.
invest.translationZh: 她投资了几家私营公司。

interested.sentenceEn: These are inspiring and hopefully will encourage librarians interested in community services and cultural outreach to make connections with each other, share ideas, and build partnerships.
interested.translationZh: 这些内容令人鼓舞，希望能激励那些对社区服务和文化推广感兴趣的图书馆员们相互建立联系、分享想法并建立合作伙伴关系。

interested.sentenceEn: W: Our audience will be most interested in learning about a career in the foreign service.
interested.translationZh: 女：我们的听众会对了解外交领域的事业最感兴趣。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interested.sentenceEn: Dr. Tim Littlewood, head of Life Sciences Department at the Natural History Museum, said, "Whether you are interested in food or disease, the history of how every organism on the planet has adapted to its environment is recorded in its genetic makeup.
interested.translationZh: 英国自然历史博物馆生命科学部主任蒂姆·利特尔伍德博士说：“无论你对食物还是疾病感兴趣，地球上每种生物如何适应环境的历史都记录在其基因构成中。”
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

interested.sentenceEn: As the wage gap has grown between those with college degrees and those without, economists have suggested that men aren't as interested in taking some of the less lucrative jobs.
interested.translationZh: 随着拥有大学学位者与没有大学学位者之间的工资差距不断扩大，经济学家认为，男性对从事一些收入较低的工作不再那么感兴趣。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

interested.sentenceEn: Research conducted on artists and scientists indicates that creative people are less interested in hanging out with others.
interested.translationZh: 针对艺术家和科学家的研究表明，富有创造力的人不太喜欢与他人交往。

interested.sentenceEn: They are interested in fairy tales.
interested.translationZh: 他们对童话故事很感兴趣。

identity.sentenceEn: Our self-concept and identity are mental concepts that influence our behavior.
identity.translationZh: 我们的自我概念和身份认同是影响我们行为的心理概念。

identity.sentenceEn: And because we identify with our commitments, withdrawing from one can feel like a threat to our identity or status.
identity.translationZh: 因为我们将自我认同与所做的承诺联系在一起，所以放弃承诺可能会让人觉得是对个人身份或地位的威胁。

identity.sentenceEn: Just as Copernicus realised the Earth is not the centre of the universe, Professor Oliver said society urgently needs a Copernican-like revolution to understand people are not detached beings but rather part of one connected identity .
identity.translationZh: 奥利弗教授表示，正如哥白尼认识到地球并非宇宙中心一样，社会迫切需要一场类似哥白尼式的革命，以理解人类并非孤立存在的个体，而是一个相互关联的整体的组成部分。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

identity.sentenceEn: "Since our bodies are essentially made anew every few weeks, the material in them alone is clearly insufficient to explain the persistent thread of an identity ."
identity.translationZh: 既然我们的身体每隔几周就基本上会更新一次，那么显然仅凭体内的物质不足以解释身份认同这一持续存在的脉络。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

identity.sentenceEn: For people associating their identity with their commitments, quitting can feel like their identity is threatened.
identity.translationZh: 对于那些将身份认同与自身承诺挂钩的人来说，放弃可能会让他们觉得自己的身份受到了威胁。

identity.sentenceEn: Strive to develop our social identity .
identity.translationZh: 努力发展我们的社会认同。

investment.sentenceEn: Today, they are a reality, and at prices that make them a plausible investment .
investment.translationZh: 如今，它们已成为现实，且其价格已使其成为一项值得投入的投资。

investment.sentenceEn: Many of those poor parents who have the vision to send their children to college have benefited from this investment , even though they have to scrape a living.
investment.translationZh: 许多贫穷的父母尽管生活拮据，但他们有远见，送孩子上大学，并且从这项投资中获益良多。
investment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

investment.sentenceEn: Before I started We Are Travel Girls, I had a successful 10-year career in finance in London, where I advised private clients on their investments .
investment.translationZh: 在创立"我们是旅行女孩"(We Are Travel Girls)之前，我在伦敦的金融行业拥有长达10年的成功职业生涯，为私人客户提供投资建议。
investment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

investment.sentenceEn: An even more important change is the move from traditional farming to building businesses that can profitably bring technology and investment to small farmers.
investment.translationZh: 一个更为重要的转变是从传统农业向建立能够为小农户带来技术和投资并从中获利的企业转型。

investment.sentenceEn: It has proved even more important to shift from traditional farming to setting up businesses that can bring technology and investment to small farmers in Africa.
investment.translationZh: 事实证明，更为重要的是从传统农业转向建立能够为非洲小农带来技术和投资的企业。

investment.sentenceEn: It will guarantee the profits from their investments .
investment.translationZh: 这将保证他们的投资收益。

ideal.sentenceEn: Unsocial tendencies like these are often far from ideal .
ideal.translationZh: 这类不合群的倾向往往远非理想。

ideal.sentenceEn: It is ideal , then, for people to start exercising when they are children or adolescents, and it is good to maintain an active lifestyle at all times regardless of your age.
ideal.translationZh: 因此，理想的情况是从儿童或青少年时期就开始锻炼，而且无论年龄大小，始终保持积极活跃的生活方式都是非常有益的。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

ideal.sentenceEn: Many laymen presume that there is a single standard way of speaking in each country, with one single standard accent, and that this perceived standard is inherently the best form of speech, but linguists(语言学家) often point out that the concept of a standard accent is better understood as an ideal rather than a reality.
ideal.translationZh: 许多门外汉认为每个国家都有一种标准的说话方式和一种标准的口音，并觉得这种公认的标准形式在本质上就是语言的最佳形态。但语言学家经常指出，标准口音的概念与其说是一种现实，不如说是一个理想化的标准。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ideal.sentenceEn: As part of the struggle, various media outlets have presented women whose bodies don't correspond to the so-called ideal .
ideal.translationZh: 作为这场抗争的一部分，各种媒体平台开始呈现那些不符合所谓“理想身材”的女性形象。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

ideal.sentenceEn: Once the desired beauty ideal has been internalized, users are given tools or features to change their appearance to suit the accepted beauty ideal such as editing the image, choosing the ideal filter, the right background.
ideal.translationZh: 一旦用户将理想的 beauty 标准内化，系统就会提供工具或功能让他们调整自己的外貌以符合公认的 beauty 标准，例如编辑图片、选择理想滤镜和合适的背景。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ideal.sentenceEn: A fight is going on to remove pressure on women to conform to an absurd beauty ideal .
ideal.translationZh: 一场旨在消除女性承受的、需符合荒谬 beauty 理想的压力的斗争正在进行中。

insect.sentenceEn: The use of chemicals to get rid of insects or unwanted plant life can increase indirect emissions as they can include petroleum-based ingredients.
insect.translationZh: 使用化学物质清除昆虫或多余植物可能会增加间接排放，因为这些化学物质可能含有石油基成分。
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

insect.sentenceEn: Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops.
insect.translationZh: 农田蜘蛛物种通过捕食那些与我们争夺农作物的昆虫，提供着宝贵的生态系统服务。
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

insect.sentenceEn: British butterflies are the most studied group of insects in the world, due to the long tradition of collecting and observing them.
insect.translationZh: 由于长期以来人们有收集和观察蝴蝶的传统，英国蝴蝶成为了世界上研究最为深入的昆虫类群。
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

insect.sentenceEn: And while information about insect populations is gathered by experiments that measure the numbers hitting windscreens or traps, there have been few attempts to count spiders.
insect.translationZh: 尽管科学家通过统计撞击挡风玻璃或落入陷阱的昆虫数量来收集有关昆虫种群的信息，但针对蜘蛛数量的统计却寥寥无几。
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

insect.translationZh: 它已将某些昆虫转变为一种新的食物来源。

indeed.sentenceEn: M: It was indeed majestic, and yet, dare I say, masculine at the same time.
indeed.translationZh: 男士：它的确宏伟壮丽，但恕我直言，同时也带有阳刚之气。
indeed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

indeed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

indeed.translationZh: 结果显示，那些观看了白手起家片段的人确实对美国梦抱有明显更强的信念。

interact.sentenceEn: More than just books and banks of computers, libraries are still places where individuals gather to explore, interact , and imagine.

interact.sentenceEn: Public libraries, through such programs as The Human Library and Socrates Café, can help build small communities of difference that encourage people to interact with and learn from each other through dialogue.
interact.translationZh: 公共图书馆通过“真人图书馆”和“苏格拉底咖啡馆”等项目，有助于建立多元小社区，鼓励人们通过对话相互交流、相互学习。

insight.translationZh: 对这一变革的历史回顾与分析，或许能为我们洞察其中的机遇提供宝贵启示。

insight.sentenceEn: Some researchers in the field of creativity, in fact, believe that insight occurs during the reflection and relaxation that follows a period of intense activity.
insight.translationZh: 事实上，一些创造力领域的研究人员认为，洞察力产生于一段紧张活动后的反思与放松时刻。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

insight.sentenceEn: The report provides insight into a government review which looks at how to reform technical education and how to ensure students get good value for money.
insight.translationZh: 这份报告为一项政府评估提供了见解，该评估旨在研究如何改革技术教育以及如何确保学生获得良好的经济回报。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

insight.sentenceEn: Their work offers new insights into the impact word choice has on how we differentiate between statements expressing what is real versus what is merely possible.
insight.translationZh: 他们的研究为我们提供了新的见解，揭示了词汇选择如何影响我们区分表达真实情况的陈述与仅表达可能性的陈述。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

insight.sentenceEn: The doctors also offer health, dietary and lifestyle advice where necessary, including insight on everything from recognizing postnatal(产后的) depression to daily exercise.
insight.translationZh: 医生们还会在必要时提供健康、饮食和生活方式方面的建议，内容包罗万象，从如何识别产后抑郁症到日常锻炼等各种见解。

indicator.sentenceEn: GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing, and should not be the primary goal of governments.
indicator.translationZh: GDP增长并非衡量一个国家表现的良好指标，也不应成为政府的首要目标。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

indicator.sentenceEn: Researchers have also found that a person's mood, which can be an indicator of a larger illness, triggers a dog's sense of smell.
indicator.translationZh: 研究人员还发现，一个人的情绪——它可能是某种严重疾病的指示器——会触发狗的嗅觉。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

indicator.sentenceEn: A person's voice can also carry indicators of illness.
indicator.translationZh: 人的声音也能传递疾病的迹象。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

indicator.sentenceEn: This is especially true as the study makes clear that information presented as fact evokes special responses in our brains, which are distinct from when we process the same content with clear indicators of uncertainty.
indicator.translationZh: 这一点尤为正确，因为该研究明确表明，以事实形式呈现的信息会在我们的大脑中引发特殊反应，这与我们处理带有明确不确定性指示词的相同内容时的反应截然不同。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

indicator.sentenceEn: But the first phase—a passion for invention—is not a reliable indicator that the firm will still be open for business a few years later.
indicator.translationZh: 但第一阶段——对发明创造的热情——并不能可靠地预示公司在几年后依然能够存续经营。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

indicator.sentenceEn: It is an indicator of government performance.
indicator.translationZh: 这是衡量政府绩效的一个指标。

intense.sentenceEn: Revisit things during moments of relaxation after a period of intense work.
intense.translationZh: 在高强度工作后的放松时刻，重新审视事物。

intense.sentenceEn: Some researchers in the field of creativity, in fact, believe that insight occurs during the reflection and relaxation that follows a period of intense activity.
intense.translationZh: 事实上，一些创造力领域的研究人员认为，洞察力产生于一段紧张活动后的反思与放松时刻。
intense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

intense.sentenceEn: Dr. Mustahid regularly recommends her patients to take a daily thirty-minute morning walk before the sun gets too intense .
intense.translationZh: 穆斯塔希德医生通常会建议她的病人每天清晨在阳光变得过于强烈之前散步30分钟。

intense.sentenceEn: We sometimes need to take responsibility for mistakes, but intense guilt and shame aren't a desirable outcome in the long run.
intense.translationZh: 我们有时需要为自己的错误承担责任，但从长远来看，强烈的内疚和羞耻感并非理想结果。
intense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

intense.sentenceEn: And we also know that intense emotions are associated with stronger memories and preferences.
intense.translationZh: 我们还知道，强烈的情绪与更深刻的记忆和更坚定的偏好密切相关。
intense.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

intense.translationZh: 青少年的情绪更为强烈。

interpret.sentenceEn: The authors of the study concede that some might interpret the study's findings to mean that they can delay starting an exercise program but this would be a mistake.
interpret.translationZh: 研究报告的作者们承认，有些人可能会将研究结果解读为可以推迟开始锻炼计划，但这种观点是错误的。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

interpret.sentenceEn: What is less clear is whether these behaviors should be considered as evidence that fish are self-aware, even though in the past these same behaviors have been interpreted as self-awareness in so many other animals.
interpret.translationZh: 尚不明确的是，这些行为是否应被视为鱼类具有自我意识的证据，尽管在过去，同样的行为在许多其他动物身上都被解读为自我意识的表现。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interpret.sentenceEn: One issue is that people may not interpret "variety" the way nutritionists intend.
interpret.translationZh: 问题之一在于，人们对“多样性”的理解可能与营养学家的初衷不符。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

interpret.sentenceEn: Otherwise, people might interpret feedback as some kind of personal attack.
interpret.translationZh: 否则，人们可能会把反馈解读为某种人身攻击。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

interpret.sentenceEn: How do pessimists interpret the U.S. trade deficit in June?
interpret.translationZh: 悲观主义者如何解读美国6月份的贸易逆差？

interpret.sentenceEn: Their creators interpret the universal principle of beauty each in their preferred way.
interpret.translationZh: 它们的创作者以各自偏爱的方式诠释美的普遍原则。

investigate.sentenceEn: I headed straight to graduate school to investigate the social problems that fascinated me.
investigate.translationZh: 我直接进入研究生院，研究那些让我着迷的社会问题。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

investigate.sentenceEn: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement.
investigate.translationZh: 作为社会科学家，我们研究了正当缺席和非正当缺席与儿童学业成绩之间的关系。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

investigate.sentenceEn: Have you gone to those places of business to investigate whether any legitimate positions might be available for someone with your background?
investigate.translationZh: 你有没有去那些公司询问过，像你这样背景的人是否有合适的职位空缺？
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

investigate.sentenceEn: Dr. Helen Adam from Edith Cowan University's School of Education investigated the cultural diversity of children's books.
investigate.translationZh: 埃迪斯科文大学教育学院的海伦·亚当博士对儿童书籍的文化多样性进行了调查。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

investigate.sentenceEn: Recently, he decided to formally investigate just how often his fellow researchers in psychology and neuroscience make what he believes are erroneous—or at least premature—causal connections between music and intelligence.
investigate.translationZh: 最近，他决定正式调查，在他看来，他的心理学和神经科学领域的同行们究竟有多么频繁地在音乐与智力之间建立错误的——或者至少是草率的——因果联系。

investigate.sentenceEn: Investigate all possible ways to become a celebrity in the art world.
investigate.translationZh: 探索在艺术界成名的所有可能途径。

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Lagging grid infrastructure struggles to transport this overabundance of green energy from Germany's north to its industrial south, meaning many factories still run on coal and gas.
infrastructure.translationZh: 落后的电网基础设施难以将德国北部过剩的绿色能源输送到南部工业区，这意味着许多工厂仍在使用煤炭和天然气。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Transportation, too, needs to be updated and infrastructure extended to link distant regions to Silicon Valley and the city.
infrastructure.translationZh: 此外，交通系统也需要升级，基础设施也需要扩建，以便将偏远地区与硅谷及旧金山市连接起来。

infrastructure.sentenceEn: We also have accepted the idea that college presidents, and their many vice-presidents, should be paid like their counterparts in the business world and that higher education requires an elaborate, up-to-date technology infrastructure .
infrastructure.translationZh: 我们还接受了这样一种观念：大学校长及其众多副校长的薪酬应当与商界对应职位相当，并且高等教育需要复杂先进的技术基础设施。

infrastructure.sentenceEn: The solution lies not just in better infrastructure , but in better social incentives.
infrastructure.translationZh: 解决之道不仅在于改善基础设施，还在于建立更有效的社会激励机制。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Most of that money needs to go towards improving agricultural infrastructure .
infrastructure.translationZh: 这些资金中的大部分需要用于改善农业基础设施。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Its grid infrastructure's capacity has fallen behind its development of green energy.
infrastructure.translationZh: 其电网基础设施的容量已落后于绿色能源的发展。

internal.sentenceEn: Plus, Feist says, many artists "are trying to make sense of their internal world and a lot of internal personal experiences that they're trying to give expression and meaning to through their art."
internal.translationZh: 此外，费斯特表示，许多艺术家“正试图理解自己的内心世界，以及许多个人内在体验，他们正努力通过艺术为这些体验赋予表达和意义。”

internal.sentenceEn: To overcome this kind of internal obstacle, recall your other positive traits and personality characteristics.
internal.translationZh: 要克服这类内在障碍，请回想一下你其他的积极特质和人格特征。

internal.sentenceEn: "You might imagine micro-robots as agents to repair or assemble small structures or machines in industry or as surgical assistants to clear clogged arteries, to stop internal bleeding, or to eliminate cancerous tumours—all in minimally invasive procedures," Rogers said.
internal.translationZh: 罗杰斯说：“你可以将微型机器人想象成工业中用于修复或组装小型结构或机器的工具，或者是外科手术的助手，用于疏通堵塞的动脉、止血或消除癌性肿瘤——所有这些都通过微创手术完成。”
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

internal.sentenceEn: They also rated the extent to which they believed success in life is related to various internal factors (such as ambition) and external factors (such as family wealth).
internal.translationZh: 他们还对自己认为人生成功与各种内部因素（如雄心壮志）和外部因素（如家庭财富）相关的程度进行了评分。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

internal.sentenceEn: Thus, a focus on an internal sense of satisfaction, purpose or meaning is less important.
internal.translationZh: 因此，对内在满足感、目标感或意义感的关注就没那么重要了。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

internal.sentenceEn: Why does the woman say she wants to choose internal medicine as her specialty?
internal.translationZh: 这位女士为什么说她想选择内科作为自己的专业？

imagination.sentenceEn: At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable.
imagination.translationZh: 势利的根源在于缺乏想象力和自信，无法判断世上谁才具有价值。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

imagination.sentenceEn: A key tool for creating goals and progressing, is using our imagination .
imagination.translationZh: 想象力是制定目标和取得进步的关键工具。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

imagination.sentenceEn: But it's beginning to be better understood, because using our imagination is actually one of the most powerful things we could ever do.
imagination.translationZh: 但人们开始更好地理解这一点，因为运用想象力实际上是我们能做的最有力的事情之一。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

imagination.sentenceEn: It is speculated to have been invented by the imagination of the said anonymous author at the Athens Weekly Banner in the aforementioned 1890 front page article titled "Deeded to Itself", which by the way contained several elements that are much more easily proved to be false.
imagination.translationZh: 据推测，这是那位匿名作者在《雅典每周旗帜报》1890年那篇标题为《赠予自身》的头版文章中凭空捏造的，顺便说一句，该文章包含若干内容现已被轻易证实为虚假。

imagination.sentenceEn: But humans are uniquely imaginative, and we use our evolved imagination to travel into virtual worlds that are full of danger.
imagination.translationZh: 但人类拥有独特的想象力，我们运用进化而来的想象力，进入充满危险的虚拟世界。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

imagination.sentenceEn: It triggers their imagination to travel into dangerous virtual worlds.
imagination.translationZh: 这激发了他们的想象力，让他们进入危险的虚拟世界进行探索。

imply.sentenceEn: The researchers stress, however, that their dietary recommendations do not imply dietary diversity is never positive, and that, in the past, diversity in diets of whole, unprocessed food may have actually been very beneficial.
imply.translationZh: 然而，研究人员强调，他们的饮食建议并不意味着饮食多样性绝无益处，事实上，在过去，全天然、未经加工的食物构成的多样化饮食可能曾非常有益。
imply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

imply.sentenceEn: This implies that a lack of female academics is not the problem.
imply.translationZh: 这意味着，女性科研人员数量不足并非问题所在。
imply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

imply.sentenceEn: A second option is to bring that person down; that is, to suppress their cooperation or work ethic, infer selfish motives for their actions, or imply real or imagined hypocrisy.
imply.translationZh: 第二种选择是打压这个人；也就是说，压制他们的合作精神或职业道德，臆断他们的行为动机自私自利，或者暗示他们真的或想象中的虚伪。
imply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

imply.sentenceEn: The evidence implies that people with similar jobs and incomes are more culturally alike, regardless of where they live.
imply.translationZh: 有证据表明，拥有相似工作和收入的人在文化上更为相似，无论他们生活在哪里。
imply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

imply.sentenceEn: Measurements of density and composition imply that Venus originally formed out of basically the same stuff as Earth.
imply.translationZh: 密度和成分的测量结果表明，金星最初是由与地球基本相同的物质形成的。
imply.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

imply.sentenceEn: What does the author imply we should do to avoid being snobbish?

investor.sentenceEn: But today the bambara murukku is one of CFF's best reviewed foods and they are aiming to get it into grocery stores, pointing to the success of crops like quinoa to potential investors .

investor.sentenceEn: Millions of dollars of investor funding and years of labor were lost.
investor.translationZh: 数百万美元的投资者资金和数年的心血付诸东流。

investor.sentenceEn: Aside from the salvors, their investors , and the maritime archaeologists who serve as expert witnesses, the battles sweep in local and international governments and organizations like UNESCO that work to protect under-water heritage.
investor.translationZh: 除了打捞人员、他们的投资者以及担任专家证人的海洋考古学家外，这些争夺战还将地方和国际政府以及像联合国教科文组织这样致力于保护水下遗产的组织卷入其中。

investor.sentenceEn: Over the prior three years, he and his crew had obtained 14 state permits to survey a nearly 260-square-kilometer area off the cape; they worked 250 days a year, backed by investor funds of, he claims, US $4 million.
investor.translationZh: 在过去三年中，他和他的团队获得了14项州级许可，用于勘测海角附近近260平方公里的海域；他们每年工作250天，他声称这得到了400万美元投资者资金的支持。

investor.sentenceEn: Pritchett claims he got support of millions of dollars from investors for his shipwreck exploration.
investor.translationZh: 普里切特声称他的沉船探索得到了投资者数百万美元的支持。

investor.sentenceEn: It will continue to arouse the interest of music investors .
investor.translationZh: 它将继续引起音乐投资者的兴趣。

illustrate.sentenceEn: One of the bizarre legacies of the past decade is the popularity of the "cyborg look", which illustrates what Americans will look like in 2050.
illustrate.translationZh: 过去十年最奇特的产物之一是“电子人外观”的流行，它描绘了2050年美国人的模样。
illustrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

illustrate.sentenceEn: These online interactive maps illustrate the formative power of snail mail.
illustrate.translationZh: 这些在线互动地图展示了传统邮件的形成性力量。
illustrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

illustrate.sentenceEn: No matter what techniques we use, this growing field of research illustrates that saving nature requires encouraging people to experience it more often and more deeply.
illustrate.translationZh: 无论我们采用何种方法，这一日益发展的研究领域都表明，拯救自然需要鼓励人们更频繁、更深入地体验自然。

illustrate.sentenceEn: It's difficult to grasp just how impressive this is, without understanding that just over a year ago it would have taken three to five days to process the exact same data set, illustrating the advancements that have been achieved in precision agriculture and remote sensing in recent years.
illustrate.translationZh: 如果不了解就在一年多前，处理完全相同的数据集需要三到五天时间，就很难体会到这有多么令人印象深刻。这一对比也充分说明了近年来精准农业和遥感技术取得的进步。

illustrate.sentenceEn: Which illustrates the irony of the responsibility/fault fallacy: evading responsibility feels comfortable, but turns out to be a prison; whereas assuming responsibility feels unpleasant, but ends up being freeing.

incredibly.translationZh: 红绿灯在混乱的城市街道中具有极其重要的作用。

incredibly.sentenceEn: Others live incredibly wealthy and luxurious lives and so the wealth is distributed in a very unequal manner.
incredibly.translationZh: 另一些人则过着极其富有奢华的生活，因此财富分配极为不均。

incredibly.sentenceEn: Overall, Moss outlines the industry's dependence on making their products inexpensive, super delicious, and incredibly convenient for consumers.
incredibly.translationZh: 总体而言，莫斯阐述了食品行业对产品策略的依赖——即生产价格低廉、美味可口且对消费者而言极其便利的食品。
incredibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

incredibly.sentenceEn: M: We'll be incredibly happy to be your new tenants.

independence.sentenceEn: One reason is that in the first few decades of independence , many African governments neglected farming as they focused on industrialising their economies.

independence.sentenceEn: Creating a gap between her income and spending required a paradigm shift and entailed sacrifice and commitment, but by going into financial lockdown, Nicole gained financial independence .
independence.translationZh: 要在收入和支出之间创造差距，需要彻底转变观念，并意味着要做出牺牲和承诺。但通过实施财务封锁，妮可获得了经济独立。

independence.sentenceEn: This ideal of independence also contains a tremendous amount of unselfishness.
independence.translationZh: 这种独立的理想中还包含着极大的无私。

independence.sentenceEn: But it is also true that old people have been influenced by an American ideal of independence and autonomy.
independence.translationZh: 但同样真实的是，老年人也受到了美国独立自主这一理想观念的影响。
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

independence.sentenceEn: We feel greater independence than we actually possess because money allows us to buy things without building any relationships.
independence.translationZh: 我们感受到的独立感比我们实际拥有的要强烈，因为金钱让我们无需建立任何关系就能买到东西。

independence.sentenceEn: They cannot gain independence without fighting for it.
independence.translationZh: 不经抗争，他们就无法获得独立。

influential.sentenceEn: Even so, this idea of a standard accent is influential and many workplace and educational environments perpetuate the idea that accents that deviate from the current standard are less appropriate, or even inappropriate.
influential.translationZh: 即便如此，这种标准口音的概念依然具有影响力，许多职场和教育环境都在强化这样一种观念：即偏离现有标准的口音是不够得体、甚至是不合时宜的。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

influential.sentenceEn: Some employ their persuasive vocabulary and influential communication style to win workplace arguments by compelling people to perform the intended action.
influential.translationZh: 有些人会运用他们富有说服力的词汇和具有影响力的沟通方式，通过迫使他人按其意图行事来赢得职场争论。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

influential.sentenceEn: This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin's highly influential work, The Origin of Species, which established the doctrine of natural selection.
influential.translationZh: 这种前理性世界的图景仍然被广泛接受，查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作《物种起源》进一步强化了这一观点，该书确立了自然选择学说。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

influential.sentenceEn: According to the National Association of Colleges and Employers' 2016 report, study abroad and foreign language fluency were not very influential in the employee hiring processes, but 55 percent of employers looked for computer skills on applicants' resumes.
influential.translationZh: 根据美国大学与雇主协会2016年的报告，出国留学经历和外语流利程度对员工招聘过程影响不大，但55%的雇主会在求职者简历中寻找计算机技能。

influential.sentenceEn: As an adult, Marconi had an intuition that he had to be loyal to politicians in order to be influential .
influential.translationZh: 成年后，马可尼凭直觉意识到，要想具有影响力，就必须对政客忠诚。

influential.sentenceEn: There were quite a few female editors who also distinguished themselves as influential psychology researchers.
influential.translationZh: 也有不少女性编辑同时作为有影响力的心理学研究者脱颖而出。

innovative.sentenceEn: There are surely endless examples of innovative library services for children, including the Middle Country Public Library's Nature Explorium, which engages children in learning about the natural world.
innovative.translationZh: 针对儿童的创新图书馆服务无疑有无数例证，其中包括中郡公共图书馆的“自然探索馆”，该馆让孩子们参与到自然世界的学习中。

innovative.sentenceEn: There, an innovative teaching model has taken hold, and is spreading to other schools in the district and beyond.
innovative.translationZh: 在那里，一种创新的教学模式已经扎根，并正在推广到该学区内外的其他学校。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

innovative.sentenceEn: The innovative drive lives in every human brain, and the resulting war against the repetitive is what powers the massive changes that distinguish one generation from the next.
innovative.translationZh: 创新的驱动力存在于每个人的大脑中，而由此产生的对重复性的抗争，正是推动巨大变革的力量，这些变革使得一代人与另一代人截然不同。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

innovative.sentenceEn: To benefit both researchers and the communities, the need to find innovative , accessible ways to share the work cannot be overstated.
innovative.translationZh: 为了使研究人员和社区双方受益，寻找创新且易于理解的方式来分享研究成果的重要性怎么强调都不为过。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

innovative.sentenceEn: What does initial research suggest regarding Westwood's innovative teaching model?
innovative.translationZh: 关于韦斯特伍德创新教学模式，初步研究有何发现？

innovative.sentenceEn: Innovative people are not constrained in connecting unrelated concepts.
innovative.translationZh: 创新人才在连接不相关概念时不受束缚。

input.sentenceEn: Like a lamb, I complied, after which the website accepted my input .
input.translationZh: 我像顺从的小羊羔一样照办了，随后网站接受了我输入的信息。
input.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

input.sentenceEn: So, to gain access to an automated service that will benefit financially from my input , I first have to do some unpaid labor to help improve the performance of autonomous vehicles.
input.translationZh: 所以，为了获得一项能从我的输入中获利的自动化服务，我首先得干些义务劳动，去帮他们改进自动驾驶汽车的性能。
input.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

input.sentenceEn: "Learning from less variable input is often fast, but may fail to generalise to new stimuli."
input.translationZh: 从变化较小的输入中学习通常速度很快，但可能无法推广到新的刺激。
input.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

input.sentenceEn: "If they don't actually have some kind of immediate input , then they can follow up later. They don't need to be sitting in this hour-long meeting."
input.translationZh: 如果他们实际上没有什么即时意见要提，那就可以之后再跟进。没必要非得坐在这儿开这个一小时的会。

input.sentenceEn: One theory is that more variable input can highlight which aspects of a task are relevant and which are not.
input.translationZh: 有一种理论认为，更多变的输入可以突出显示任务的哪些方面是相关的，哪些是不相关的。
input.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

input.sentenceEn: Managers like her, who seek input even from non-experts to shape their decisions, can find greater support and cooperation from their workforce, she says.
input.translationZh: 她说，像她这样的管理者，即使是向非专家征求意见以制定决策，也能从员工那里获得更多支持与合作。

interpersonal.sentenceEn: Any job that involves people requires good interpersonal skills, and any law professional needs to be very eloquent at articulating that argument.
interpersonal.translationZh: 任何涉及人际交往的工作都需要良好的人际沟通能力，而任何法律专业人士都需要非常善于清晰地阐述论点。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: For some, this meaning is religious, some political and some interpersonal .
interpersonal.translationZh: 对一些人来说，这种意义是宗教层面的，一些是政治层面的，还有一些是人际关系层面的。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: Online "friends" made through social media do not follow the normal psychological progression of an interpersonal relationship.
interpersonal.translationZh: 通过社交媒体结交的线上“朋友”并不遵循人际关系正常的心理发展进程。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: This is surprising when you consider the prevailing emphasis by scholars and trainers and managers on the importance of cultivating close interpersonal relationships at work.
interpersonal.translationZh: 然而，考虑到学者、培训师和管理者们普遍强调在职场中培养密切人际关系的重要性，我的这种感受着实令人惊讶。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: Less inherently interpersonal subjects, such as math, could acquire a social aspect through team problem solving and peer tutoring.
interpersonal.translationZh: 对于数学等本质上较少涉及人际交往的学科，可以通过团队解决问题和同伴辅导的方式赋予其社交属性。

interpersonal.sentenceEn: It is conducive to our forging better interpersonal relationships.
interpersonal.translationZh: 这有利于我们建立更好的人际关系。

involvement.sentenceEn: The active involvement of users is reflected in the gamified(游戏化的) interaction offered by the social media platforms—the ability to like, write a comment, compare, share.
involvement.translationZh: 用户的积极参与体现在社交媒体平台提供的游戏化互动中——点赞、评论、比较、分享等功能。
involvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

involvement.sentenceEn: The internalization of accepted beauty norms is much more effective when there is active involvement in the learning process.
involvement.translationZh: 当个体积极参与学习过程时，对公认 beauty norms 的内化会更加有效。
involvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

involvement.sentenceEn: In matters of science at least, those who value their common sense over methodological, collaborative investigation imagine themselves to be more free in their thinking, unbound by involvement with the group, but in reality they are tightly bound by their capabilities and perspectives.
involvement.translationZh: 至少在科学领域，那些重视自身常识胜过系统性协作研究的人，自认为思维更加自由，不受群体参与的束缚，然而事实上，他们却被自身的能力和视角牢牢限制。
involvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

involvement.sentenceEn: For them, the bond of loyalty extends only to the line of romantic involvement .
involvement.translationZh: 对她们而言，忠诚的纽带仅延伸到恋爱关系这一层。
involvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

involvement.sentenceEn: What do some experts say about doctors' involvement in medical cost analysis?
involvement.translationZh: 一些专家对医生参与医疗成本分析有何看法？

involvement.sentenceEn: No law required the involvement of a third party in certification.
involvement.translationZh: 目前没有法律要求认证过程必须有第三方参与。

inform.sentenceEn: Two papers published today in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition outline the case for and against using the concept of ultra-processed foods to help inform dietary guidelines beyond conventional food classification systems.
inform.translationZh: 今日发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上的两篇论文，探讨了在传统食品分类系统之外，是否应使用超加工食品概念为膳食指南提供信息的支持与反对观点。
inform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

inform.sentenceEn: Marketing may help socialize children as consumers, inform them about products, and help them carve out unique identities as they reach adulthood.
inform.translationZh: 市场营销或许能帮助儿童适应消费者角色，向他们介绍产品信息，并在他们成年过程中帮助他们塑造独特的身份认同。
inform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

inform.sentenceEn: And," Brudney adds, "if you, as a patient, suggest that you might like to control even part of the situation or be consulted or informed , then you are considered difficult.
inform.translationZh: 布鲁德尼还说：“而且，如果你作为患者，哪怕只是暗示想对部分情况有所掌控，或是希望得到咨询或告知，就会被视为难缠的病人。”
inform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

inform.sentenceEn: Informed travelers also are better able to distinguish between multinational companies and local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits for local residents.
inform.translationZh: 有见识的旅行者还能更好地区分跨国公司和当地企业家——后者的业务能为当地居民带来直接的社会、环境和经济效益。
inform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

inform.sentenceEn: In the same way, the idea that the resolution of age-associated disease like heart disease and stroke will inform us about ageing is not based on sound science or logic.
inform.translationZh: 同理，认为解决心脏病和中风等与年龄相关的疾病就能帮助我们了解衰老过程的观点，是缺乏可靠科学依据和逻辑基础的。
inform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

inform.sentenceEn: The new teaching model helps inform the teacher how their instruction is received.
inform.translationZh: 新的教学模式有助于教师了解学生对其教学的接受情况。

integrate.sentenceEn: By the early 2000s, supercomputing had advanced enough that scientists could integrate weather forecasting models with such measurements.
integrate.translationZh: 到21世纪初，超级计算技术已经足够先进，科学家们能够将天气预报模型与这些测量数据整合起来。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

integrate.sentenceEn: Apple is an outstanding case of a company whose unique capabilities give it a worldwide competitive advantage, particularly with respect to its ability to build platforms from a product base that integrates functional and aesthetic design.
integrate.translationZh: 苹果公司是一个杰出案例，其独特能力使其拥有全球竞争优势，特别是在基于产品构建平台方面的能力——这些产品整合了功能与美学设计。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: The way to change people's minds is to become friends with them, to integrate them into your tribe, to bring them into your circle.
integrate.translationZh: 改变他人想法的方法是与他们成为朋友，让他们融入你的群体，将他们带入你的圈子。

integrate.sentenceEn: "Many parents fear their language is an obstacle, a problem, and if they abandon it their child will integrate better," says Antonella Sorace of the University of Edinburgh.
integrate.translationZh: 爱丁堡大学的安东内拉·索拉奇说：“许多家长担心自己的母语是一种障碍，是个问题，认为如果他们放弃母语，孩子就能更好地融入社会。”

integrate.sentenceEn: There is huge potential for artificial intelligence and machine learning to revolutionize agriculture by integrating these technologies into critical markets on a global scale.
integrate.translationZh: 通过将人工智能和机器学习技术整合到全球关键市场中，这些技术在彻底变革农业方面具有巨大潜力。

integrate.sentenceEn: In a certain tiny college, rigorous academic work and traditional manual labor are integrated .
integrate.translationZh: 在某所小型学院中，严谨的学术工作与传统体力劳动融为一体。

interpretation.sentenceEn: Even on the broadest interpretation of 'happiness' as prosperity or 'life satisfaction', people want different things.
interpretation.translationZh: 即便将“幸福”作最宽泛的解读，理解为富裕或“生活满意度”，人们的追求依然各不相同。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

interpretation.sentenceEn: Depending on your position, you might reject the interpretation that these behaviors in a fish satisfy passing the test at all.
interpretation.translationZh: 根据你所持的立场，你可能会拒绝接受‘鱼类的这些行为足以让其通过测试’这一解读。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

interpretation.sentenceEn: If hereditarians want to advance their cause it will require more balanced interpretation and not just acts of advocacy.
interpretation.translationZh: 如果遗传决定论者想要推进其主张，就需要更平衡的解释，而不仅仅是宣扬。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

interpretation.sentenceEn: The correct interpretation of this statement is not about copying, but rather about creating your own style.
interpretation.translationZh: 这句话的正确解读并非鼓励抄袭，而是倡导形成自己的风格。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

interpretation.sentenceEn: What does the speaker think affects people's interpretation of beauty?
interpretation.translationZh: 说话者认为什么影响人们对美的理解？

interpretation.sentenceEn: It is subject to interpretation of statistics.
interpretation.translationZh: 这取决于对统计数据的解读。

invisible.sentenceEn: It's invisible to us during the new moon, because our satellite is parked right between us and the sun; the so-called dark side of the moon is lit up like Las Vegas, but the side we can see is in shadow.
invisible.translationZh: 新月期间我们看不到月亮，因为我们的卫星正好位于地球和太阳之间；所谓的月球暗面被照得如同拉斯维加斯般灯火通明，而我们能看到的一面却处于阴影中。

invisible.sentenceEn: Using computer technology, Pritchett and his crew created intricate, color-coded maps marked with the GPS coordinates of thousands of finds, all invisible under a meter of sand.
invisible.translationZh: 普里切特和他的团队利用计算机技术绘制出了复杂的彩色编码地图，上面标注了数千处发现物的GPS坐标，而这些发现物全都隐藏在一米厚的沙子之下，肉眼无法看见。

invisible.sentenceEn: "I believe that increased biophobia is a major, but invisible , threat to global biodiversity," Soga says.
invisible.translationZh: 我认为，生物恐惧症的加剧是对全球生物多样性的一个重大却又隐蔽的威胁。

invisible.sentenceEn: This is the age women start to become " invisible "—our value, attractiveness and power supposedly diminished by the vanishing of youth.
invisible.translationZh: 人们常说，到了这个年纪，女性开始变得“隐形”——我们的价值、魅力和影响力，似乎都随着青春的消逝而减退。
invisible.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

invisible.sentenceEn: Who are regarded as "largely invisible " on TV shows?
invisible.translationZh: 在电视节目中，谁被认为“在很大程度上是隐形的”？

invisible.sentenceEn: Their behaviors can be an invisible threat to society.
invisible.translationZh: 他们的行为可能对社会构成一种隐形威胁。

implication.sentenceEn: This could have implications in reducing conflict between stray dogs and humans.
implication.translationZh: 这可能有助于减少流浪狗与人类之间的冲突。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

implication.sentenceEn: This had implications for obesity, as researchers found a greater prevalence of obesity amongst people with a greater dietary diversity.
implication.translationZh: 这对肥胖问题具有重要启示，因为研究人员发现，饮食多样性较高的人群中肥胖发生率也更高。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

implication.sentenceEn: While the term AI conjures up anxieties about killer robots or catastrophic levels of unemployment, there are other, deeper implications .
implication.translationZh: 虽然“人工智能”一词会让人联想到对杀人机器人或灾难性失业水平的焦虑，但它还存在其他更深层次的影响。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

implication.sentenceEn: Central to the problem is a person's capacity to make choices, particularly judgments that have moral implications .
implication.translationZh: 问题的核心在于人类做出选择的能力，尤其是进行具有道德含义的判断的能力。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

implication.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the deeper implications of AI?
implication.translationZh: 关于人工智能的更深层次影响，我们了解到什么？

implication.sentenceEn: They could understand the implications of human commands.
implication.translationZh: 它们能够理解人类指令的含义。

impose.sentenceEn: Of course, governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens.
impose.translationZh: 当然，政府无法将生活满意度强加于公民。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

impose.sentenceEn: Now it is clear that these improvements provide great benefits but also impose health costs.
impose.translationZh: 如今，这些便利设施在带来巨大益处的同时，也让人们付出了健康代价，这一点已十分明确。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

impose.sentenceEn: Implicitly or explicitly, American fashion addressed a democracy, whereas traditional Paris-based fashion was prescriptive and imposed on women, willing or not.
impose.translationZh: 无论是含蓄表达还是直白呈现，美国时尚都体现了民主精神，而传统的巴黎时尚则具有规定性，无论女性是否愿意，都强加于她们。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

impose.sentenceEn: M: In France, the government has banned supermarkets from throwing away edible foods and imposed harsh penalties on businesses that fail to comply with the regulations.
impose.translationZh: 男主持人：在法国，政府已禁止超市丢弃可食用食品，并对不遵守该规定的企业实施严厉处罚。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

impose.sentenceEn: How come the UK has been slow in imposing the tourist tax?
impose.translationZh: 英国为何迟迟没有征收旅游税？

impose.sentenceEn: Governments cannot impose happiness on citizens.
impose.translationZh: 政府无法将幸福强加于公民。

improved.sentenceEn: Over and above a vastly improved provision of therapeutic mental healthcare, there are preventative measures for improving mental health that governments could and should adopt.
improved.translationZh: 除了大幅改善治疗性精神卫生服务外，政府还可以而且应该采取一些预防性措施来改善国民心理健康。
improved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

improved.sentenceEn: One key benefit of solitude is improved creativity.
improved.translationZh: 独处的一个关键好处是提升创造力。

improved.sentenceEn: Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas, country-dwellers across the world are moving out, contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, and leaving the countryside in desolation.
improved.translationZh: 受城市地区经济改善的吸引，世界各地的农村居民纷纷迁出，导致人口稠密城市过度拥挤，而乡村则日益荒芜。
improved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

improved.sentenceEn: In addition, there is better overall health and improved medical knowledge in care.
improved.translationZh: 此外，整体健康状况有所改善，护理方面的医学知识也得到了提升。
improved.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

improved.sentenceEn: The use of fertiliser and improved seeds can help Africa's small farmers impressively increase crop yields.
improved.translationZh: 使用化肥和改良种子能帮助非洲小农显著提高作物产量。
这证明了福利水平的提高。

industrial.sentenceEn: "We're urging Members of Parliament to ensure automation does not just benefit a wealthy few like previous industrial revolutions."
industrial.translationZh: 我们正敦促国会议员确保自动化进程不会像之前的工业革命那样，仅仅让少数富人受益。

industrial.sentenceEn: The debate centers around a system developed by Monteiro and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing, ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed.
industrial.translationZh: 这场争论围绕着由Monteiro及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据食品的工业加工程度对其进行分类，范围从非加工食品到超加工食品。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

industrial.sentenceEn: In fact, for the first time ever since the Industrial Revolution, about half of the global population can be considered middle class.
industrial.translationZh: 事实上，自工业革命以来，全球约有一半人口首次可以被视为中产阶级。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

industrial.sentenceEn: When a group of Australians was asked why they believed climate change was not happening, about 36% said it was "common sense", according to a report published last year by the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organization.
industrial.translationZh: 根据澳大利亚联邦科学与工业研究组织去年发布的一份报告，当一组澳大利亚人被问及为何认为气候变化并未发生时，约36%的人表示这是“常识”。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

industrial.sentenceEn: Industrial fishing for krill(磷虾) in the unspoilt waters around Antarctica is threatening the future of one of the world's last great wildernesses, according to a new report.
industrial.translationZh: 一份新报告指出，在南极洲周边未受污染的水域进行工业化磷虾捕捞，正威胁着世界上最后一片大型荒野的未来。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

industrial.sentenceEn: Its industrial south is used to running factories on conventional energy supplies.
industrial.translationZh: 其南部工业区习惯使用传统能源供电的工厂运营模式。

inner.sentenceEn: You may feel as if you are an independent individual, acting autonomously in the world; that you have an unchanging inner self that persists throughout your lifetime, acting as a central anchor-point with the world changing around you.
inner.translationZh: 你可能会觉得自己是一个独立的个体，在世界上自主行动；你拥有一个终生不变的内在自我，在周围世界不断变化的同时，作为一个核心锚点存在。
inner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

inner.sentenceEn: The outer edge of the rainbow arc is red, while the inner edge is violet.
inner.translationZh: 彩虹弧的外边缘是红色的，而内边缘是紫色的。
inner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

inner.sentenceEn: This way you make use of your emotions without losing your balance and inner stability.
inner.translationZh: 这样，你就能善用自己的情绪，同时又不会失去平衡和内心的稳定。
inner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

inner.sentenceEn: Our brains are made up of a primitive inner core and a more evolved and rational outer core.
inner.translationZh: 我们的大脑由一个原始的内核和一个更进化、更理性的外核组成。
inner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inner.sentenceEn: Rather, it changes the intensity of our inner experience.
inner.translationZh: 相反，独处会改变我们内心体验的强度。
inner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

inner.sentenceEn: He has found that our inner self and material self are interconnected.
inner.translationZh: 他发现我们的内在自我与物质自我是相互关联的。

instant.sentenceEn: In recent years she has used some of the forgotten crops grown at CFF, such as moringa and bambara groundnut, to make everything from instant soup to Indian snacks.
instant.translationZh: 近年来，她利用了一些在CFF种植的被遗忘作物，如辣木和班巴拉花生，制作从速食汤到印度小吃等各种食品。

instant.sentenceEn: They gather "data exhaust" left by employees' email and instant messaging apps, and use name badges equipped with radio-frequency identification devices and microphones.
instant.translationZh: 他们收集员工通过电子邮件和即时通讯应用产生的“数据废气”，并使用配备了射频识别装置和麦克风的姓名徽章。
instant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

instant.sentenceEn: But he warns that some people go into therapy expecting too much—an instant transformation of themselves from a pathological(病态的) perfectionist to a (still high-achieving) non-perfectionist.
instant.translationZh: 但他警告说，有些人接受治疗时期望过高——希望自己能立即从病态的完美主义者转变为（依然成就斐然的）非完美主义者。

instant.sentenceEn: W: Anything you initially gain from the instant satisfaction of telling it like it is, you might lose down the track by injuring your future career prospects.
instant.translationZh: 你从"实话实说"中获得的一时满足，最终可能会损害你未来的职业前景，让你得不偿失。
instant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

instant.sentenceEn: Instead of a quest for knowledge, it engages us in an endless zest(热情) for instant approval from an audience, for which we are constantly but unconsciously performing.
instant.translationZh: 它没有激发我们对知识的追求，反而使我们热衷于不断从观众那里获得即时认可，为此我们一直在无意识地表演。
instant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

instant.sentenceEn: It has an instant effect on your body chemistry.
instant.translationZh: 它会立即影响你的身体化学。

imitate.sentenceEn: Part of what's exciting about this finding is that the babies didn't just imitate the adult's actions.
imitate.translationZh: 这项发现的有趣之处在于，婴儿不仅仅是模仿成人的动作。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

imitate.sentenceEn: So the next time you hear someone arguing passionately that everyone should embrace nonconformity and avoid imitating others, you might laugh a little bit.
imitate.translationZh: 所以下次当你听到有人慷慨激昂地主张每个人都应该追求特立独行、避免模仿他人时，你或许会微微一笑。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

imitate.sentenceEn: That is, they copied irrationally: Instead of doing only what was necessary to get their reward, children slavishly imitated every action they'd witnessed.
imitate.translationZh: 也就是说，他们的模仿是非理性的：孩子们没有只做获取奖励所必需的动作，而是盲从地模仿了他们所看到的每一个行为。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

imitate.sentenceEn: So if you want to compliment someone on the work they have done and imitate it, just make sure you do it the right way to avoid committing plagiarism.
imitate.translationZh: 因此，如果你想赞赏并模仿他人的作品，务必确保方式得当，避免构成抄袭。
imitate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

imitate.sentenceEn: Imitated Burberry products discouraged luxury consumers from buying its genuine products.
imitate.translationZh: 仿冒博柏利产品阻碍了奢侈品消费者购买其正品。

imitate.sentenceEn: They meet challenges by imitating others carefully.
imitate.translationZh: 人类通过仔细模仿他人来应对挑战。

isolated.sentenceEn: Examples of people kept in captivity, children kept isolated in abusive orphanages, and prisoners kept in solitary confinement all show how prolonged solitude can lead to hallucinations(幻觉) and other forms of mental instability.
isolated.translationZh: 被囚禁者、在虐待性孤儿院中与世隔绝的儿童以及被单独监禁的囚犯，这些例子都表明长期独处会导致幻觉和其他形式的精神不稳定。

isolated.sentenceEn: More than a third of seniors in the poll said they felt lonely at least some of the time, and 27% said they sometimes or often felt isolated .
isolated.translationZh: 调查中超过三分之一的老年人表示他们至少有时会感到孤独，27%的老年人称他们有时或经常感到孤立。
isolated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

isolated.sentenceEn: In one experiment, people who reported feeling isolated were more likely than others to attribute consciousness to various gadgets.
isolated.translationZh: 在一项实验中，自称感到孤独的人比其他人更有可能将意识赋予各种电子设备。
isolated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

isolated.sentenceEn: King penguins are the second-largest type of penguin and only breed on specific isolated islands in the Southern Ocean where there is no ice cover and easy access to the sea.
isolated.translationZh: 王企鹅是体型第二大的企鹅种类，它们仅在南大洋特定的孤立岛屿上繁殖，这些岛屿没有冰层覆盖，且易于进入大海。
isolated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

isolated.sentenceEn: Lots of research demonstrates that being socially isolated is harmful to the elderly.
isolated.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社交孤立对老年人有害。

isolated.sentenceEn: It was totally isolated as a sleepy village.
isolated.translationZh: 它曾是一个与世隔绝的宁静村庄。

impress.sentenceEn: And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress .
impress.translationZh: 这就是为什么我们被这种强烈的渴望所驱使——渴望成就，渴望给人留下深刻印象。
impress.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

impress.sentenceEn: Impressing a sense of dependence upon and gratitude toward foreign strangers is therefore an uphill task.
impress.translationZh: 因此，要让人们对外来陌生人产生依赖感和感激之情，是一项艰巨的任务。

impress.sentenceEn: However, the exclusively local and face-to-face nature of economic and political organization in the ancient and prehistoric worlds constantly impressed upon these primitive peoples the uncontrollable reality of others and their needs.
impress.translationZh: 然而，在古代和史前世界，经济与政治组织完全局限于地方范围且具有面对面交流的特性，这使这些原始民族不断感受到他人及其需求是一种无法控制的现实。

impress.sentenceEn: One could therefore present Napoleon in terms of his desire to impress or Churchill in terms of his lonely gloom.
impress.translationZh: 因此，我们可以从拿破仑渴望给人留下深刻印象的角度来讲述他，或者从丘吉尔孤独忧郁的心境来呈现他。

impress.sentenceEn: Wardian was very much impressed by a race director's sense of adventure.
impress.translationZh: 瓦尔迪安对一位赛事总监的冒险精神印象深刻。

impress.sentenceEn: They are deeply impressed by Danielle Steel's daily work schedule.
impress.translationZh: 他们对丹妮尔·斯蒂尔的每日工作安排印象深刻。

indigenous.sentenceEn: Going against stereotypes, the incorporation of indigenous aspects, along with your underlying signature touch, made this collection a statement of the season.
indigenous.translationZh: 突破刻板印象，融入本土元素，再加上您标志性的独特风格，使这个系列成为本季的时尚宣言。
indigenous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

indigenous.sentenceEn: Social and environmental activists, scientists and indigenous groups have called the Paris Agreement of the United Nations Climate Change Conference in December 2015 insufficient, weak, or compromised.
indigenous.translationZh: 社会与环境活动家、科学家以及原住民群体认为，2015年12月联合国气候变化大会达成的《巴黎协定》不够充分、力度不足或是已有所妥协。

indigenous.sentenceEn: Rough estimates of their population went as high as five billion and they accounted for around 40 percent of the total indigenous bird population of North America in the early 19th century.
indigenous.translationZh: 粗略估计，它们的数量高达50亿只，在19世纪初期占北美本土鸟类总数量的约40%。
indigenous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

indigenous.sentenceEn: W: Well, it follows my expedition to study the vegetation indigenous to the rainforest in equatorial areas of Southeast Asia.
indigenous.translationZh: W：好的，这部纪录片记录了我的考察之旅，我去研究东南亚赤道地区雨林的原生植被。
indigenous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

indigenous.sentenceEn: Currently, under an aggressive Hindu nationalist government, Muslims, Christians, disadvantaged classes and indigenous communities are being compelled to give up their traditional foods.
indigenous.translationZh: 当前，在奉行激进印度教民族主义的政府统治下，穆斯林、基督徒、弱势群体以及原住民正被迫放弃他们的传统饮食。
indigenous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

indigenous.sentenceEn: Some of its indigenous languages are dying out.
indigenous.translationZh: 岛上的一些土著语言正在消亡。

indulge.sentenceEn: But if you want to stop indulging in video games, simply deciding you will go for a run might not be as effective.
indulge.translationZh: 但如果你想不再沉迷电子游戏，仅仅决定去跑步可能效果并不理想。

indulge.sentenceEn: But some people experience a powerful urge to keep eating, even after indulging in a huge meal, a behavior that makes little sense, as most adults are well-versed in the dangers of obesity, which researchers have shown correlates with innumerable health issues and is even linked to increased mortality risk.
indulge.translationZh: 但有些人即使享用了一顿大餐后，仍会感到强烈的继续进食的冲动——这种行为看似毫无道理，因为大多数成年人都深知肥胖的危害，研究人员已证实肥胖与无数健康问题相关，甚至与死亡风险增加有关。
indulge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

indulge.sentenceEn: That's because rather than indulging employees or neglecting them, ethical leaders communicate very direct and clear expectations.
indulge.translationZh: 这是因为有道德的领导者既不会纵容员工，也不会忽视他们，而是会传达非常直接明确的期望。
indulge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

indulge.sentenceEn: First, don't indulge in despair, because despair leads to inertia and doing nothing means certain disaster.
indulge.translationZh: 首先，不要沉溺于绝望，因为绝望会导致惰性，而无所作为则意味着灾难必然降临。
indulge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

indulge.sentenceEn: Recent research has also shown that indulging in a high-fat and high-sugar diet may have negative effects on your brain, causing learning and memory deficits.
indulge.translationZh: 近期研究还表明，沉溺于高脂高糖饮食可能会对大脑产生负面影响，导致学习和记忆能力下降。
indulge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

indulge.sentenceEn: Employees who indulge in internet surfing are most likely to quit.
indulge.translationZh: 沉迷于上网的员工最有可能离职。

initiate.sentenceEn: One of the reasons for this is because we mistakenly believe the strategies we used to initiate the change will be equally effective in helping us continue the change.
initiate.translationZh: 其中一个原因是我们错误地认为，那些用来启动变革的策略同样能有效帮助我们持续推进变革。

initiate.sentenceEn: Initiating a new behavior usually seems like the hardest part of the process of change.
initiate.translationZh: 开始新行为通常似乎是改变过程中最困难的部分。

initiate.sentenceEn: People who are talked to have equally positive experiences as those who initiate a conversation.
initiate.translationZh: 被搭话的人与主动发起交谈的人有着同样积极的体验。
initiate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

initiate.sentenceEn: There's no one around to offer praise or initiate collaboration, no one to make greater use of our interests and talents.
initiate.translationZh: 周围没有人给予表扬或发起合作，也没有人能更好地发挥我们的兴趣和才能。
initiate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

initiate.sentenceEn: Research shows it is quite another challenge to maintain a behavioral change after you have initiated it.
initiate.translationZh: 研究表明，开始改变行为后，保持这种改变是另一项相当大的挑战。

initiate.sentenceEn: He has initiated a university reform.
initiate.translationZh: 他已发起一项大学改革。

innovate.sentenceEn: This is the Bay Area's opportunity to prove that it can innovate more than just technology.
innovate.translationZh: 这正是旧金山湾区证明自己不仅能在技术上创新的机会。

innovate.sentenceEn: It could be that our raw intelligence gave us an unprecedented ability to think outside the box, innovating solutions to thorny problems as people migrated across the globe.
innovate.translationZh: 这可能是因为我们原始的智力赋予了我们前所未有的跳出思维定势的能力，在人类向全球迁移的过程中不断创新，解决棘手难题。
innovate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

innovate.sentenceEn: Now, many people, both laymen and experts, believe that only geniuses innovate .
innovate.translationZh: 如今，许多人，无论是门外汉还是专家，都认为只有天才才会创新。
innovate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

innovate.sentenceEn: Creative retailers are using the new technologies to innovate just about everything stores do from managing inventory, to marketing, to getting paid.
innovate.translationZh: 富有创新精神的零售商正在利用新技术对商店运营的方方面面进行创新，从库存管理、市场营销到支付方式。

innovate.sentenceEn: Digital technology makes it possible for businesses to innovate restaurant models.
innovate.translationZh: 数字技术使企业能够创新餐饮模式。

innovate.sentenceEn: Innovate technologies to ensure the safety of users' accounts.
innovate.translationZh: 创新技术以确保用户账户安全。

inquiry.sentenceEn: By both actively promoting civil discourse through these programs, and modeling and upholding the principles of free inquiry and expression for all, libraries help individuals rediscover the importance of and increased need for civil discourse in American life.
inquiry.translationZh: 图书馆通过这些项目积极促进文明对话，并为所有人树立和坚持自由探究与表达的原则，帮助个人重新认识到文明对话在美国生活中的重要性和日益增长的必要性。

inquiry.sentenceEn: But the extent to which individuals can do this on their own is a function of how well integrated they are with communities of systematic inquiry in the first place.
inquiry.translationZh: 但个人独立进行这种思考的能力高低，首先取决于他们与系统性探究群体的融合程度。
inquiry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

inquiry.sentenceEn: The Paris prosecutor's office has opened an inquiry into "involuntary destruction by fire", indicating they believe the cause of the blaze was accidental rather than criminal.
inquiry.translationZh: 巴黎检察院已对“过失火灾毁坏”展开调查，表明他们认为火灾原因是意外事故而非刑事犯罪。

inquiry.sentenceEn: Since he began to informally announce the network at farming conferences and on social media, he's received a steady stream of inquiries from interested farmers.
inquiry.translationZh: 自从他开始在农业会议和社交媒体上非正式地宣传这个网络以来，他就不断收到感兴趣的农民的咨询。

inquiry.sentenceEn: We found that when we taught participants to ask "What if?" and "How can?" questions that nobody present would know the answer to and that would spark exploration, they engaged in better inquiry at the next exhibit—asking more questions, performing more experiments and making better interpretations of their results.
inquiry.translationZh: 我们发现，当我们教参与者提出诸如“如果……会怎样？”和“如何才能……？”这类在场无人能立即回答但能激发探索欲望的问题时，他们在接下来的展览中展现出更深入的探究能力——提出更多问题、进行更多实验并对结果做出更合理的解释。
inquiry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

inquiry.sentenceEn: They expect to get instantaneous responses to their inquiry .
inquiry.translationZh: 他们期望自己的询问能得到即时回应。

inspiration.sentenceEn: What was your inspiration for this piece?
inspiration.translationZh: 你创作这件作品的灵感是什么？
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

inspiration.sentenceEn: We may think of innovation as being the result of inspiration or genius, but it's really the result of developing the ideas of others further.
inspiration.translationZh: 我们或许认为创新源于灵感或天赋，但实际上，创新是在他人思想基础上进一步发展的结果。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

inspiration.sentenceEn: They come in a flash of inspiration to a select few.
inspiration.translationZh: 灵感的闪现只降临在少数精选之人身上。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

inspiration.sentenceEn: It can serve as a source of inspiration , and as an ideal jumping-off point should a musician be hit with writer's block(文思枯竭).
inspiration.translationZh: 它可以作为灵感来源，当音乐家遭遇文思枯竭时，还能成为理想的创作起点。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

inspiration.sentenceEn: The business news website Quartz held Steel up as an inspiration , writing that if only we all followed her "actually extremely liberating" example of industrious sleeplessness, we would be quick to see results.
inspiration.translationZh: 商业新闻网站Quartz将斯蒂尔誉为榜样，称只要我们都效仿她那种“实际上极为自由的”勤奋不眠模式，就能很快见到成效。
inspiration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inspiration.sentenceEn: It seeks inspiration for novel inventions.
inspiration.translationZh: 它为新颖的发明寻找灵感。

instantly.sentenceEn: It's a simple, yet profound change in perception, and what I love about it is the power it has to instantly shift us up a gear.
instantly.translationZh: 这是一种简单却深刻的观念转变，而我喜欢它的一点是，它拥有瞬间推动我们提升一个层次的力量。
instantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

instantly.sentenceEn: Combined with machine learning of anticipated order volumes and the minute-by-minute cooking data generated by systems such as QSR, that robot fleet could deliver almost instantly .
instantly.translationZh: 结合对预期订单量的机器学习，以及由 QSR 等系统生成的每分钟烹饪数据，该机器人机群几乎可以实现即时交付。

instantly.sentenceEn: They are not always instantly obvious, and certainly not always direct.
instantly.translationZh: 这些回报并非总能立竿见影，当然也并非总是直接的。
instantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

instantly.sentenceEn: Instead of instantly satisfying their wishes, parents should help them work out a plan to earn things they'd like to have.
instantly.translationZh: 父母不应立即满足孩子的愿望，而应帮助他们制定计划，通过努力去获得想要的东西。
instantly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

instantly.sentenceEn: News of the Notre Dame Cathedral catastrophe instantly caught media attention throughout the world.
instantly.translationZh: 巴黎圣母院的灾难新闻立即引起了全球媒体的关注。

instantly.sentenceEn: It was the painting that instantly made her rich.
instantly.translationZh: 正是这幅画让她一夜成名，财源滚滚。

intricate.sentenceEn: M: Well, depending on the ensuing operative scenario, if I need to wipe the system directories clean in order to reconfigure default protocols, then my first intervention should be to intricately retrieve all inventories that I can.
intricate.translationZh: 男：嗯，这取决于接下来的操作场景。如果我需要清空系统目录以重新配置默认协议，那么我的首要措施应该是尽可能详细地检索所有清单。
intricate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

intricate.sentenceEn: Using glitter, I drew similar intricate patterns onto the velvet cape.
intricate.translationZh: 我用闪光粉在天鹅绒披风上绘制了类似的精致图案。
intricate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

intricate.sentenceEn: Nevertheless, I would suggest you start with computer science because there will be many intricate visuals you will have to produce as part of your projects.
intricate.translationZh: 不过，我建议你从计算机科学开始，因为在你的项目中，你需要制作许多复杂的视觉效果。
intricate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

intricate.sentenceEn: We build intricate habitats, devise complex recipes for our food, wear clothes that reflect constant changes in fashion, communicate with elaborate signs, symbols, and sounds, and travel between habitats on wings and wheels of our own design.
intricate.translationZh: 我们建造精巧复杂的居所，设计五花八门的食谱，穿着紧跟时尚潮流变化的服装，通过繁复的手势、符号和声音进行交流，还借助自己设计的翅膀与车轮穿梭于不同的栖息地之间。
intricate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

intricate.sentenceEn: What does the example of the biologist who shared an intricate analogy show?
intricate.translationZh: 那位分享复杂类比的生物学家的例子说明了什么？

intricate.sentenceEn: Draw intricate patterns onto a traditional power suit.
intricate.translationZh: 在传统西装上绘制精致复杂的图案。

irrational.sentenceEn: If someone stops caring about people and cuts off all contact, this could point to an irrational neglect of social relations.
irrational.translationZh: 如果一个人不再关心他人并断绝所有联系，这可能表明其对社会关系存在非理性的忽视。

irrational.sentenceEn: Where does the seemingly irrational human preference for over-imitation come from?
irrational.translationZh: 人类这种看似非理性的过度模仿倾向从何而来？
irrational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

irrational.sentenceEn: Our prevailing mood of despair is irrational .
irrational.translationZh: 我们普遍存在的绝望情绪是不理性的。
irrational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

irrational.sentenceEn: People can be so irrational sometimes.
irrational.translationZh: 人们有时候真是太不理性了。
irrational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

irrational.sentenceEn: Psychology is like the rational study of irrational feelings.
irrational.translationZh: 心理学就像是对非理性情感的理性研究。
irrational.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

irrational.sentenceEn: They use manipulative language to mask their irrational choices.
irrational.translationZh: 他们使用操纵性的语言来掩盖自己不合理的选择。

irrelevant.sentenceEn: Researchers Tarek Amer, Jordana Wynn and Lynn Hasher looked at several behavioral and brain imaging studies, which show that older adults have difficulty suppressing information that is no longer relevant and that when searching for a specific memory, they often retrieve other, irrelevant memories along with it.
irrelevant.translationZh: 研究人员塔里克·阿米尔、乔丹娜·韦恩和林恩·哈舍查看了几项行为和脑成像研究，这些研究表明，老年人难以抑制不再相关的信息，并且在搜索特定记忆时，他们往往会同时检索到其他不相关的记忆。
irrelevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

irrelevant.sentenceEn: If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job, or worse, irrelevant to everyday work tasks.
irrelevant.translationZh: 如果不这样做，他们会将这种体验视为游戏，难以应用到工作中，甚至更糟的是，与日常工作任务毫不相关。
irrelevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

irrelevant.sentenceEn: It's irrelevant whether their need for a desired schedule is due to, say, parenting responsibilities, or a craving to hang out with a best mate.
irrelevant.translationZh: 员工期望特定工作安排的原因无关紧要，无论是出于育儿责任，还是渴望与好友相聚。
irrelevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

irrelevant.sentenceEn: The experimenters demonstrated how to open the box to retrieve the treat, but they also included the irrelevant step of tapping on the box with a stick.
irrelevant.translationZh: 实验人员演示了如何打开盒子取出零食，但他们还加入了一个无关的步骤——用小棍子敲击盒子。
irrelevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

irrelevant.sentenceEn: There is always the risk that the recruiter will research information that is inaccurate or irrelevant .
irrelevant.translationZh: 因为招聘人员很可能会去搜索一些不准确或不相关的信息，这始终存在风险。
irrelevant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

irrelevant.sentenceEn: Older adults often retrieve irrelevant memories along with what they want.
irrelevant.translationZh: 老年人在回忆想要的内容时，常常会同时想起一些不相关的记忆。

ideology.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies .
ideology.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

ideology.sentenceEn: With the rapid progress in the economy, it is natural that people's ideology is bound for change.
ideology.translationZh: 随着经济的快速发展，人们的思想观念发生变化是必然的。
ideology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

ideology.sentenceEn: Whether it feels right is usually a reflection of the world view and ideologies we have internalised, and that frames how we interact with new ideas.
ideology.translationZh: 某件事是否感觉正确，通常反映了我们内心已接纳的世界观和意识形态，而这会影响我们与新观点互动的方式。
ideology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

ideology.sentenceEn: The obesity crisis will not have a solution devised by left or right ideology —but experience indicates that the private sector needs the incentive of regulation before it starts taking public health emergencies seriously.
ideology.translationZh: 肥胖危机不会有左翼或右翼意识形态所设计的解决方案——但经验表明，私营部门需要监管的激励，才会开始认真对待公共卫生紧急事件。
ideology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第7句

ideology.sentenceEn: Public libraries can help build small communities of people with different backgrounds and ideologies .
ideology.translationZh: 公共图书馆有助于建立由不同背景和意识形态的人们组成的小型社区。

ideology.sentenceEn: It is the basis for the internalisation of individuals' ideologies .
ideology.translationZh: 它是个人意识形态内化的基础。

imperative.sentenceEn: The mistake we make with this is that whilst self-acceptance is imperative , it should actually be used as the basis for growth.
imperative.translationZh: 我们在这方面常犯的错误是：尽管自我接纳至关重要，但它实际上应该被用作成长的基础。
imperative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

imperative.sentenceEn: M: Yes, I completely understand how imperative it would be to respect Mr. Sanchez's private life.
imperative.translationZh: 男：是的，我完全理解尊重桑切斯先生的私人生活是多么重要。
imperative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

imperative.sentenceEn: This correlation suggests that the layout and design of cities can hinder or promote healthier lifestyle choices and it is imperative that urban planners bear this in mind.
imperative.translationZh: 这种相关性表明，城市的布局和设计可能阻碍也可能促进人们做出更健康的生活方式选择，城市规划者必须牢记这一点。
imperative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

imperative.sentenceEn: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
imperative.translationZh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某一领域的专家并不自动意味着这位学者就有资格向非科学受众传播该领域知识。
imperative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

imperative.sentenceEn: There are also the financial imperatives .
imperative.translationZh: 还有财务方面的迫切需求。
imperative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第6句

imperative.sentenceEn: It is imperative to have appropriate titles to explain scientific issues.
imperative.translationZh: 为科学问题提供恰当的解释说明至关重要。

impressive.sentenceEn: The campaign led to an impressive increase in product sales of more than 10%.
impressive.translationZh: 该活动使产品销量显著增长了10%以上。
impressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

impressive.sentenceEn: It's difficult to grasp just how impressive this is, without understanding that just over a year ago it would have taken three to five days to process the exact same data set, illustrating the advancements that have been achieved in precision agriculture and remote sensing in recent years.
impressive.translationZh: 如果不了解就在一年多前，处理完全相同的数据集需要三到五天时间，就很难体会到这有多么令人印象深刻。这一对比也充分说明了近年来精准农业和遥感技术取得的进步。

impressive.sentenceEn: But even more impressive is the progress in just a single year: human interventions fell from 0.8 times per thousand miles to 0.2, a 400% improvement.
impressive.translationZh: 但更令人印象深刻的是仅在一年内取得的进步：人工干预从每千英里0.8次降至0.2次，改进了400%。
impressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

impressive.sentenceEn: Something very impressive to me is many people think that luck is important and that natural talent is something you must have in order to be successful.
impressive.translationZh: 让我印象非常深刻的是，很多人认为运气很重要，而且认为要想成功就必须具备天赋。
impressive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

impressive.translationZh: 它们构成了一本令人印象深刻的相册。

indoor.sentenceEn: But outdoor pollution also leads to indoor pollution, and people still suffer.
indoor.translationZh: 但室外污染也会导致室内污染，人们依然深受其害。
indoor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

indoor.sentenceEn: It is hoped that the work could pave the way for simple modification of air conditioning units so that they can also clean polluted indoor air.
indoor.translationZh: 研究人员希望这项工作能为空调设备的简易改造铺平道路，使其能够同时净化受污染的室内空气。
indoor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

indoor.sentenceEn: While there are some existing technologies to purify indoor air, they can be inefficient, expensive or produce harmful by-products.
indoor.translationZh: 虽然现有一些室内空气净化技术，但它们可能存在效率低下、价格昂贵或产生有害副产品的问题。
indoor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

indoor.sentenceEn: Less than an hour away by snowmobile, Chinese labourers have updated the Great Wall Station, a vital part of China's plan to operate five bases on Antarctica, complete with an indoor badminton court and sleeping quarters for 150 people.
indoor.translationZh: 乘坐雪地摩托不到一小时的路程，中国工人对长城站进行了翻新改造。该站是中国计划在南极洲运营五个科考站的重要组成部分，内部设有羽毛球场馆和可容纳150人的宿舍。

indoor.sentenceEn: What do we learn from the passage about existing technologies to purify indoor air?
indoor.translationZh: 关于现有的室内空气净化技术，我们从文章中了解到了什么？

indoor.sentenceEn: They try various ways to purify indoor air.
indoor.translationZh: 他们尝试了各种方法来净化室内空气。

inherently.sentenceEn: Many laymen presume that there is a single standard way of speaking in each country, with one single standard accent, and that this perceived standard is inherently the best form of speech, but linguists(语言学家) often point out that the concept of a standard accent is better understood as an ideal rather than a reality.
inherently.translationZh: 许多门外汉认为每个国家都有一种标准的说话方式和一种标准的口音，并觉得这种公认的标准形式在本质上就是语言的最佳形态。但语言学家经常指出，标准口音的概念与其说是一种现实，不如说是一个理想化的标准。
inherently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

inherently.sentenceEn: Since many people see music as such an inherently human expression, it is often considered as too precious to impart to technology.
inherently.translationZh: 由于许多人将音乐视为一种与生俱来的人类表达方式，因此人们常常认为它太过珍贵，不应托付给技术。
inherently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

inherently.sentenceEn: "Humans inherently avoid dangerous organisms such as bees, but children these days avoid even harmless insects such as butterflies and dragonflies(蜻蜓)," he says.
inherently.translationZh: 他说：“人类本能会避开蜜蜂等危险生物，但如今的孩子们甚至会避开蝴蝶和蜻蜓这类无害昆虫。”

inherently.sentenceEn: The findings challenged the idea that homework was " inherently good." The researchers concluded that there was an upper limit to the correlation between homework and achievement, suggesting that high school students shouldn't be doing more than two hours of homework a night.
inherently.translationZh: 这些研究结果对家庭作业"天生有益"的观点提出了挑战。研究人员得出结论，家庭作业与学业成绩之间的相关性存在上限，建议高中生每晚的家庭作业不应超过两小时。
inherently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

inherently.sentenceEn: Music researchers tend, like Schellenberg, to be musicians themselves, and as he noted in his recent paper, "the idea of positive cognitive and neural side effects from music training (and other pleasurable activities) is inherently appealing."
inherently.translationZh: 音乐研究者往往和舍伦贝格一样，本身就是音乐家。正如他在近期论文中所指出的那样：'音乐训练（以及其他愉悦活动）能产生积极的认知和神经副作用，这种观点本身就具有吸引力。'

inherently.sentenceEn: All species inherently depend on others for survival.
inherently.translationZh: 所有物种的生存本质上都依赖于其他物种。

install.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, in US trials, the self-ordering screens that McDonald's is currently installing at its 1,300 UK restaurants yielded a reported 30% rise in order values.
install.translationZh: 与此同时，在美国的试点中，麦当劳目前在英国 1,300 家餐厅安装的自助点餐机据报道使订单额增长了 30%。

install.sentenceEn: Knight installed a similar gas light, semaphore(臂板信号) system near London's Westminster Bridge in December of 1868.
install.translationZh: 1868年12月，奈特在伦敦威斯敏斯特桥附近安装了一套类似的煤气灯臂板信号系统。

install.sentenceEn: A gas leak caused one of the signal lights to explode on its police officer operator within a month of being installed .
install.translationZh: 在一盏信号灯安装不到一个月的时间里，由于煤气泄漏，导致该灯在负责操作的警员身上发生了爆炸。

install.sentenceEn: For guests, I can relocate the movable wall and utilize the foldable guest beds I installed .
install.translationZh: 有客人时，我可以移动活动墙，使用我安装的折叠式客床。
install.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第7句

install.sentenceEn: More than 90 metres of cable were incorrectly installed ; 4,000 doors were wrongly numbered; escalators were too short.
install.translationZh: 90多米电缆安装错误；4000扇门编号有误；自动扶梯尺寸过短。
install.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

interviewer.sentenceEn: An interviewer may well think, why would this role be any different for you?
interviewer.translationZh: 面试官很可能会想：这份工作对你来说又能有什么不同呢？
interviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

interviewer.sentenceEn: When a person goes to a job interview, their interviewer has presumably read their résumé, so they don't need to repeat the information.
