interviewer.translationZh: 当一个人参加工作面试时，面试官很可能已经看过了他们的简历，因此他们无需重复简历上的信息。
interviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interviewer.sentenceEn: And yet, not a single interviewer has ever asked me about my educational background.
interviewer.translationZh: 然而，没有一个面试官曾经问过我的教育背景。

interviewer.sentenceEn: Once the interviewers have been briefed, I send the client a schedule and then they get back to me with deadlines.
interviewer.translationZh: 在给访员们做过工作简介后，我会给客户发送一份日程安排，然后他们会告诉我各项工作的截止日期。
interviewer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第3句

interviewer.sentenceEn: None of the author's job interviewers cared which college she went to.
interviewer.translationZh: 作者的任何一位面试考官都不曾关心她就读过哪所大学。

interviewer.sentenceEn: It may leave a negative impression on the interviewer .
interviewer.translationZh: 这可能会给面试官留下负面印象。

inborn.sentenceEn: Pet dogs can often readily understand a wide range of their owners' commands and gestures, but are these abilities inborn or are they exclusively learned through training?
inborn.translationZh: 宠物狗通常能轻松理解主人的各种指令和手势，但这些能力是天生的，还是完全通过训练习得的呢？
inborn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

inborn.sentenceEn: Each of us, according to research, has an inborn drive to acquire.
inborn.translationZh: 研究表明，我们每个人天生都有获取的欲望。
inborn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

inborn.sentenceEn: If you're not consciously, mindfully and intentionally harnessing this inborn drive to acquire, you might be mindlessly pursuing all the wrong things.
inborn.translationZh: 如果你没有有意识地、专注地、刻意地去驾驭这种与生俱来的获取欲，你可能会盲目地追求各种错误的东西。
inborn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

inborn.sentenceEn: Otherwise, the inborn biological upper hand that protectionists have in the form of nationalist solidarity is bound to win the day at the ballot box.
inborn.translationZh: 否则，保护主义者凭借民族主义团结所获得的先天生物学优势，必将在投票箱中获胜。

inborn.sentenceEn: What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio-economic background were taken into account.
inborn.translationZh: 该研究揭示的结果其实并不那么令人惊讶：一旦将学生的先天能力和社会经济背景纳入考虑，精英学校的教育优势在很大程度上就消失了。
inborn.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

inborn.sentenceEn: What is the dark side of our inborn drive to acquire?
inborn.translationZh: 我们天生的获取欲望背后有什么阴暗面？

indication.sentenceEn: There is no indication of any digestive issues.
indication.translationZh: 没有任何消化系统问题的迹象。
indication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

indication.sentenceEn: There have been some indications that extra protein makes the kidneys work harder, which could be problematic for individuals with a history of kidney disease and for them, the supplements may increase the risk of kidney stones, she says.
indication.translationZh: 她说，有迹象表明，过量蛋白质会加重肾脏负担，这对有肾脏疾病史的人来说可能是个问题，而且对他们而言，补充剂可能会增加肾结石的风险。

indication.sentenceEn: Early indications are that Smith will have no shortage of farm members.
indication.translationZh: 初步迹象表明，史密斯的农场会员并不短缺。

indication.sentenceEn: Average starting salaries give a clear indication of what type of training society needs its new workers to have.
indication.translationZh: 起薪平均值清楚地表明，社会需要新劳动力接受何种类型的培训。
indication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

indication.sentenceEn: Among the following mental statuses, which can be the indication of possessing mental health?
indication.translationZh: 在下列心理状态中，哪项可能是拥有心理健康的表现？

indication.sentenceEn: There is some indication of an issue with his blood circulation.
indication.translationZh: 有迹象表明他的血液循环存在问题。

indifferent.sentenceEn: It does not make us cold or indifferent but more fully present.
indifferent.translationZh: 它并没有让我们变得冷漠或无动于衷，反而让我们更加全身心地投入当下。
indifferent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

indifferent.sentenceEn: And it is these behaviors that make it easy for them to be socially indifferent .
indifferent.translationZh: 而正是这些行为使他们很容易做到“社交淡漠”。
indifferent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

indifferent.sentenceEn: In an academic analysis just published in the profoundly-respected Journal of Management, researchers have looked at the concept of " indifferent relationships".
indifferent.translationZh: 在刚刚发表于备受尊崇的《管理期刊》上的一篇学术分析中，研究人员探讨了“冷淡关系”这一概念。
indifferent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

indifferent.sentenceEn: Indifferent relationships are neither positive nor negative.
indifferent.translationZh: 冷漠关系既非积极也非消极。
indifferent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

indifferent.sentenceEn: As noted above, indifferent relationships may not always be the most helpful approach in resolving some of the issues that pop up at work.
indifferent.translationZh: 如上所述，在解决工作中出现的某些问题时，保持平淡的同事关系并非总是最有效的方法。
indifferent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

indifferent.sentenceEn: Why does the speaker say millionaires are socially indifferent ?
indifferent.translationZh: 为什么演讲者说百万富翁具有社交冷漠性？

inexpensive.sentenceEn: The new design was inexpensive enough that it allowed the installation of a lot more lights.
inexpensive.translationZh: 新设计非常便宜，足以支撑安装更多的灯具。

inexpensive.sentenceEn: Processed food is inexpensive , it's legal, and it's everywhere.
inexpensive.translationZh: 加工食品价格低廉、合法合规，而且随处可见。
inexpensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

inexpensive.sentenceEn: Overall, Moss outlines the industry's dependence on making their products inexpensive , super delicious, and incredibly convenient for consumers.
inexpensive.translationZh: 总体而言，莫斯阐述了食品行业对产品策略的依赖——即生产价格低廉、美味可口且对消费者而言极其便利的食品。
inexpensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

inexpensive.sentenceEn: American tourists enjoy stocking up on inexpensive high quality Caribbean rum while they're on vacation.
inexpensive.translationZh: 美国游客度假时喜欢大量购买价格实惠、品质上乘的加勒比朗姆酒。
inexpensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第11句

inexpensive.sentenceEn: To find inexpensive and appropriately sized tools, they collaborate and innovate.
inexpensive.translationZh: 为了找到价格实惠且尺寸适宜的工具，他们相互合作，不断创新。
inexpensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

inexpensive.sentenceEn: The report focused on poor urban areas, where farms in or near cities supply relatively inexpensive food.
inexpensive.translationZh: 该报告聚焦于贫困的城市地区，在这些地方，城市内或城市周边的农场为人们提供相对廉价的食物。
inexpensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

insurer.sentenceEn: While employers and health plans have been eager to cover virtual urgent-care visits, insurers have been far less willing to pay for telemedicine when doctors use phone, email or video to consult with existing patients about continuing issues.
insurer.translationZh: 虽然雇主和医疗计划一直热衷于为虚拟紧急护理就诊提供保险，但当医生使用电话、电子邮件或视频与现有患者就持续性问题进行咨询时，保险公司却远不愿意为这种远程医疗服务付费。

insurer.sentenceEn: Some 32 states have passed "parity"(等同的) laws requiring private insurers to reimburse doctors for services delivered remotely if the same service would be covered in person, though not necessarily at the same rate or frequency.
insurer.translationZh: 约有32个州已通过了"等同性"法律，要求私人保险公司为远程提供的医疗服务向医生支付费用，前提是这些服务若在面对面就诊时也能获得保险覆盖，不过报销比例或频次不一定相同。

insurer.sentenceEn: Some authoritative analysts doubt that the secretary would get better deals than private insurers already get.
insurer.translationZh: 一些权威分析人士怀疑，卫生与公众服务部长能否谈成比私人保险公司现有协议更优惠的价格。

insurer.sentenceEn: Governments should set safety requirements and then let insurers price the risk of the robots based on the manufacturer's driving record, not the passenger's.
insurer.translationZh: 政府应制定安全要求，然后让保险公司根据制造商的行驶记录而非乘客的记录来为机器人的风险定价。
insurer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

insurer.sentenceEn: To get access to millions of new customers, insurers would have a strong incentive to lower their prices, perhaps by accepting slimmer profit margins or demanding better deals from providers.
insurer.translationZh: 为了获取数百万新客户，保险公司将有强烈的降价动机，这可能通过接受更低的利润率或向医疗服务提供者争取更优惠的交易来实现。

insurer.sentenceEn: Unlike employers and health plans, insurers have been rather reluctant to pay for some telemedicine services.
insurer.translationZh: 与雇主和健康保险计划不同，保险公司对支付某些远程医疗服务的费用相当不情愿。

integrity.sentenceEn: Your intentional aspirational goals will also include striving to be your personal best—a person of "good" character, integrity , and trustworthiness.
integrity.translationZh: 你有意识的远大目标还应包括努力成为最好的自己——一个品格“优良”、正直可靠的人。
integrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

integrity.sentenceEn: But as many of America's most storied "highbrow"(高雅的) institutions struggle financially—the Philadelphia Orchestra's much-publicized rebound from bankruptcy is just one recent example—classical music fans and theorists are wondering how the medium can weave itself into the 21st century's cultural fabric without sacrificing its integrity .
integrity.translationZh: 然而，随着美国众多最负盛名的"高雅"艺术机构陷入财务困境——费城交响乐团从破产中强势复苏的事迹被广泛报道，这只是近期的一个例子——古典音乐爱好者和理论家们开始思考：这门艺术形式如何才能融入21世纪的文化脉络，同时又不牺牲其艺术 integrity。

integrity.sentenceEn: And if they appeal to these outlets, do they risk compromising the integrity or the intelligence of the music?
integrity.translationZh: 而如果这些高等艺术机构迎合这类媒体平台，是否会面临损害音乐的完整性或艺术性的风险？

integrity.sentenceEn: "We have to respect the security and the integrity of rights holders," says John Canning at Digital Domain, a US firm that created a hologram rapper(说唱艺人) Tupac Shakur, which appeared at the Coachella music festival in 2012, 15 years after his death.
integrity.translationZh: 美国数字领域公司的约翰·坎宁表示：“我们必须尊重权利持有人的安全与权益完整。”该公司曾于2012年为说唱艺人图派克·沙库尔制作全息影像，在其去世15年后亮相科切拉音乐节。

integrity.sentenceEn: He adds that, despite hunters' claims that hunting keeps wildlife populations in balance, hunters' license fees are used to "manipulate a few game species into overpopulation at the expense of a much larger number of non-game species, resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance."
integrity.translationZh: 他补充说，尽管猎人声称狩猎能保持野生动物数量平衡，但猎人支付的执照费用却被用来“操控少数狩猎物种过度繁殖，而牺牲大量非狩猎物种，导致生物多样性、遗传完整性和生态平衡的丧失。”
integrity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

integrity.sentenceEn: Higher institutions will be concerned about compromising the integrity of classical music if they have to resort to the television medium.
integrity.translationZh: 如果高等音乐机构不得不借助电视媒介，它们将会担心这会损害古典音乐的完整性。

intensive.sentenceEn: Ammie Kalan and her colleagues have shown, through years of intensive fieldwork, that the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior.
intensive.translationZh: 艾米·卡兰及其同事通过多年的深入实地研究表明，人类的存在本身已经侵蚀了黑猩猩行为的多样性。
intensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

intensive.sentenceEn: Reading the earnings announcements of large retail stores like Macy's, Nordstrom, and Target is about as uplifting as a tour of an intensive care unit.
intensive.translationZh: 阅读梅西百货、诺德斯特龙和塔吉特等大型零售商店的收益公告，就像参观重症监护室一样令人沮丧。

intensive.sentenceEn: Great civilizations and intensive settlement are hardly associated with the Amazon.
intensive.translationZh: 亚马逊河几乎从未与伟大文明和密集定居点联系在一起。
intensive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

intensive.sentenceEn: Some are pricey—a three-week intensive program can cost $4,500 or more—but most offer scholarships.
intensive.translationZh: 有些夏令营价格不菲——一个为期三周的强化项目可能要花费4500美元甚至更多——但大多数都提供奖学金。

intensive.sentenceEn: What did Ammie Kalan and her colleagues find through their intensive fieldwork?
intensive.translationZh: 阿米·卡兰和她的同事们通过深入的实地研究发现了什么？

intensive.sentenceEn: They are intensive studies of people's spending habits.
intensive.translationZh: 它们是对人们消费习惯的深入研究。

interpreter.sentenceEn: M: Today my guest is Dana Ivanovich, who has worked for the last 20 years as an interpreter .
interpreter.translationZh: 男主持人：今天我的嘉宾是达娜·伊万诺维奇，她从事口译工作已有20年。
interpreter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

interpreter.sentenceEn: M: Now, I'd like to begin by saying that I have on occasions used an interpreter myself as a foreign correspondent.
interpreter.translationZh: 主持人：首先我想说，作为一名驻外记者，我自己也曾偶尔使用过口译服务。
interpreter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interpreter.sentenceEn: And a lot of interpreters will say one is easier than the other, less stressful.
interpreter.translationZh: 而且很多口译员会说，这两种方式中有一种更容易，压力也更小。
interpreter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

interpreter.sentenceEn: So that the message is there, turning every single word into the target language would put too much strain on the interpreter and slow down the whole process too much.
interpreter.translationZh: 为了确保信息完整传达，将每个词都逐字翻译成目标语言会给口译员带来太大压力，也会大大拖慢整个过程。
interpreter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第4句

interpreter.sentenceEn: What does Dana say about the interpreters she knows?
interpreter.translationZh: 达娜对她认识的口译员有什么看法？

interpreter.sentenceEn: He recommended one of his best friends as an interpreter .
interpreter.translationZh: 他推荐了自己最好的朋友之一担任翻译。

intersection.sentenceEn: While you may get away with gunning it into the intersection , running a yellow can lead to tickets and dangerous accidents.
intersection.translationZh: 虽然加速冲过十字路口也许能侥幸脱身，但闯黄灯可能会导致罚单以及危险的交通事故。

intersection.sentenceEn: If an emergency vehicle came, the officer could flip a switch and clear the intersection by triggering all red lights.
intersection.translationZh: 如果救急车辆驶来，警员可以拨动开关，通过触发全红灯信号来清空十字路口。

intersection.sentenceEn: Stop and go were insufficient for the new volumes of cars zooming through intersections .
intersection.translationZh: 面对在交叉路口疾驰而过的庞大车流，原有的启停控制方式已显得捉襟见肘。

intersection.sentenceEn: The yellow light made intersections safer than the old stop and go system.
intersection.translationZh: 相比旧式的红绿灯启停系统，黄灯的引入使得交叉路口变得更加安全。

intersection.sentenceEn: Flashing Red is the same as a stop sign, generally used at four-way intersections where there is minimal traffic.
intersection.translationZh: 红灯闪烁等同于停车标志，通常用于交通流量较小的十字路口。

intersection.sentenceEn: The posts lit up on each of four corner-posts around an intersection (十字路口).
intersection.translationZh: 十字路口四周的四个角柱都亮了起来。

irritated.sentenceEn: I did so, a bit irritated .
irritated.translationZh: 我带着些许恼怒，照做了。
irritated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

irritated.sentenceEn: It is impossible to be fearful, anxious, irritated , and healthy at the same time.
irritated.translationZh: 人不可能同时处于恐惧、焦虑、愤怒的情绪中，又保持健康的状态。
irritated.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

irritated.sentenceEn: If after work you lie around on your bed and get irritated by political commentary on your phone or get stressed thinking about decisions about how to renovate your home, your brain has not received a break from high mental arousal states.
irritated.translationZh: 如果下班后你只是躺在床上，却因手机上的政治评论而心烦意乱，或是为思考如何装修房子的决策而倍感压力，那么你的大脑其实并未从高度的精神兴奋状态中得到真正的休息。

irritated.sentenceEn: Why do we find ourselves irritated for not achieving the goal?
irritated.translationZh: 为什么我们会因为没有达成目标而感到烦躁呢？

irritated.sentenceEn: They become more easily irritated in public.
irritated.translationZh: 他们在公共场合更容易生气。

isolation.sentenceEn: Still, the line between useful solitude and dangerous isolation can be blurry.
isolation.translationZh: 然而，有益的独处与危险的孤立之间的界限可能是模糊的。

isolation.sentenceEn: This is especially clear from cases of extreme social isolation .
isolation.translationZh: 这一点在极端社会隔离的案例中表现得尤为明显。

isolation.sentenceEn: Abundant research shows the harms of social isolation , considered a serious public health problem in countries that have rapidly ageing populations (though talk of a 'loneliness epidemic' may be exaggerated).
isolation.translationZh: 大量研究表明，社会隔离会带来诸多危害。在人口快速老龄化的国家，这已被视为一个严重的公共卫生问题（尽管有关“孤独流行病”的说法可能言过其实）。

isolation.sentenceEn: Since ancient times, meanwhile, people have been aware of a link between isolation and mental focus.
isolation.translationZh: 与此同时，自古以来，人们就意识到独处与精神专注之间存在联系。

isolation.sentenceEn: "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation ."
isolation.translationZh: 我们的行业发展如此缓慢，因为我们都在各自为战。
isolation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

isolation.sentenceEn: Loneliness and social isolation are growing public health concerns for people of all ages in the United States, from adolescence to the elderly.
isolation.translationZh: 在美国，从青少年到老年人，孤独和社交隔离正成为各个年龄段人群日益严重的公共健康问题。
isolation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

illusion.sentenceEn: The illusion of control can also interfere with our best judgment, leading us to overestimate our ability to control events and attain a positive outcome.
illusion.translationZh: 控制错觉还会干扰我们的理性判断，导致我们过高估计自己控制事件并获得积极结果的能力。

illusion.sentenceEn: This is the illusion I seek to tackle.
illusion.translationZh: 这就是我试图破解的错觉。
illusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

illusion.sentenceEn: Now, a British academic has claimed that human individuality is indeed just an illusion , because societies are far more interconnected at a mental, physical, and cultural level than people realise.
illusion.translationZh: 如今，一位英国学者声称，人类的个体性实际上只是一种错觉，因为社会在心理、生理和文化层面的相互联系远比人们意识到的要紧密得多。
illusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

illusion.sentenceEn: In essence, a rainbow is an optical illusion .
illusion.translationZh: 本质上，彩虹是一种光学错觉。
illusion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

illusion.sentenceEn: What is indeed just an illusion according to Professor Tom Oliver?
illusion.translationZh: 根据汤姆·奥利弗教授的观点，什么才是真正的幻觉？

illusion.sentenceEn: Drawing should be redefined as a realistic illusion .
illusion.translationZh: 绘画应该被重新定义为一种逼真的幻觉。

incidence.sentenceEn: Those who began exercising in middle age also saw reductions in their incidence of chronic diseases, such as heart disease and cancer, which were similar to the steady exercisers.
incidence.translationZh: 那些从中老年时期开始锻炼的人，其心脏病和癌症等慢性病的发病率也有所下降，下降程度与长期坚持锻炼的人群相似。
incidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

incidence.sentenceEn: If the benefits of being bilingual spill over to other aspects of cognition, then we would expect to see a lower incidence of Alzheimer's disease in bilinguals than in monolinguals, or at least a later onset of Alzheimer's for bilinguals.
incidence.translationZh: 如果双语能力带来的益处能延伸到认知的其他方面，那么我们有理由预期双语者的阿尔茨海默氏病发病率会低于单语者，或者至少双语者的阿尔茨海默氏病发病年龄会晚于单语者。

incidence.sentenceEn: Psychiatrists have a higher incidence of suicide in their profession for related reasons.
incidence.translationZh: 精神科医生的自杀率在其行业中较高，原因与此相关。
incidence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

incidence.sentenceEn: Research has found that there is a direct correlation between lack of recovery and increased incidence of health and safety problems.
incidence.translationZh: 研究发现，缺乏恢复期与健康和安全问题发生率的增加之间存在直接关联。

incidence.sentenceEn: What did James Burke recommend to reduce the incidence of cognitive decline?
incidence.translationZh: 詹姆斯·伯克建议如何降低认知衰退的发生率？

incidence.sentenceEn: It sharply reduces the incidence of traffic accidents.
incidence.translationZh: 它能显著降低交通事故的发生率。

independently.sentenceEn: There are two main groups of bats, which are believed to have evolved independent ly of each other, but both from a common ancestor.
independently.translationZh: 蝙蝠主要分为两大类，它们被认为是独立进化的，但都起源于一个共同的祖先。
independently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

independently.sentenceEn: First, it measured emotion on a scale from positive to negative, overlooking the possibility that our positive and negative emotions can fluctuate independently .
independently.translationZh: 首先，早期研究将情绪测量为一个从积极到消极的单一维度，忽略了积极情绪和消极情绪可能独立波动的可能性。
independently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

independently.sentenceEn: Diligent students tend to do their homework independently .
independently.translationZh: 勤奋的学生往往会独立完成作业。

individualism.sentenceEn: Radical individualism elevates the freedom of the individual over the collective.
individualism.translationZh: 激进的个人主义将个人自由置于集体利益之上。
individualism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

individualism.sentenceEn: Solidarity is also viewed as a reaction to the extreme emphasis on individualism and freedom of choice.
individualism.translationZh: 团结也被视为是对极度强调个人主义和选择自由的一种回应。
individualism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

individualism.sentenceEn: Professor Oliver claims that individualism is actually bad for society, and only by realising we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems.
individualism.translationZh: 奥利弗教授认为，个人主义实际上对社会有害，只有认识到我们是更大整体的一部分，我们才能解决紧迫的环境和社会问题。
individualism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

individualism.sentenceEn: These are traits, such as individualism and masculinity, that describe work-related cultural values.
individualism.translationZh: 这些特质，如个人主义和男性化特质，描述的是与工作相关的文化价值观。
individualism.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

individualism.sentenceEn: What does the author advise people to do in their pursuit of radical individualism ?
individualism.translationZh: 作者建议人们在追求激进个人主义的过程中应该怎么做？
集体主义优于个人主义。

ineffective.sentenceEn: When an employee sits through an ineffective meeting their brain power is essentially being drained away.
ineffective.translationZh: 当员工参加一场低效会议时，他们的脑力实质上在被慢慢消耗。

ineffective.sentenceEn: This combination of methods is ineffective .
ineffective.translationZh: 这种方法的结合是无效的。
ineffective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

ineffective.sentenceEn: Even though scientists play a part in transmitting information to journalists and ultimately the public, too often the blame for ineffective communication is placed on the side of the journalists.
ineffective.translationZh: 尽管科学家在将信息传递给记者并最终传递给公众方面发挥着作用，但沟通不畅的责任往往被归咎于记者。
ineffective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

ineffective.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the union in Chicago is insisting that teachers who are laid off—often for being ineffective —should get priority in new hiring.
ineffective.translationZh: 不幸的是，芝加哥的教师工会坚持认为，那些被解雇的教师——往往是因为工作能力不足而被解雇——在重新招聘时应该享有优先权。
ineffective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

ineffective.sentenceEn: What have advances in statistics and brain imaging proved ineffective ?
ineffective.translationZh: 统计学和脑成像技术的进步证明了什么方法是无效的？

ineffective.sentenceEn: It indicates their ineffective use of government resources.
ineffective.translationZh: 这表明它们对政府资源的利用效率低下。

inefficient.sentenceEn: While there are some existing technologies to purify indoor air, they can be inefficient , expensive or produce harmful by-products.
inefficient.translationZh: 虽然现有一些室内空气净化技术，但它们可能存在效率低下、价格昂贵或产生有害副产品的问题。
inefficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

inefficient.sentenceEn: Critics have long argued that organic agriculture is inefficient , requiring more land to yield the same amount of food.
inefficient.translationZh: 长期以来，批评者认为有机农业效率低下，需要更多的土地才能产出同等数量的粮食。
inefficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inefficient.sentenceEn: The stimulus package provided money to convert the inefficient , paper-driven medical system to electronic records that can be easily viewed and transmitted.
inefficient.translationZh: 经济刺激计划拨款用于将低效的、以纸质文件为主的医疗系统转变为可轻松查看和传输的电子病历系统。

inefficient.sentenceEn: Critics say Congress will give in to lobbyists and let inefficient providers off the hook(放过).
inefficient.translationZh: 批评者称，国会会向游说者让步，放过那些效率低下的医疗服务提供者。

inefficient.sentenceEn: The French card companies adopted EMV technology partly because of inefficient telephone service.
inefficient.translationZh: 法国的信用卡公司采用EMV技术，部分原因是电话服务效率低下。

inefficient.sentenceEn: They can be costly and inefficient .
inefficient.translationZh: 它们可能成本高昂且效率低下。

infection.sentenceEn: Often these infections lead to death.
infection.translationZh: 这些感染往往会导致死亡。
infection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

infection.sentenceEn: I got a throat infection last week and had to go to the hospital to get some antibiotics as I really wasn't getting any better.
infection.translationZh: 上周我喉咙感染了，因为一直没见好转，不得不去医院开了些抗生素。
infection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

infection.sentenceEn: Consulting a random doctor patients will never meet, they say, further fragments the health-care system, and even minor issues such as upper respiratory(上呼吸道的) infections can't be thoroughly evaluated by a doctor who can't listen to your heart or feel your swollen glands.
infection.translationZh: 他们表示，咨询一位患者素未谋面的随机医生会进一步分割医疗系统，而且像上呼吸道感染这样的小病，医生如果无法听诊心脏或触摸肿大的腺体，也无法进行彻底评估。

infection.sentenceEn: For years, many of us have relied on antibiotic use to treat various infections .
infection.translationZh: 多年来，我们许多人都依赖抗生素来治疗各种感染。
infection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

infection.sentenceEn: In the past, health experts warned us that the day would come in which it would become very difficult to provide medical care for even common problems, such as lung infection or severe sore throat.
infection.translationZh: 过去，健康专家曾警告我们，总有一天，即便是肺炎或严重喉痛这类常见疾病，也将变得难以医治。
infection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

infection.sentenceEn: He was fighting a throat infection .
infection.translationZh: 他当时正在和喉咙感染作斗争。

informed.sentenceEn: That enables you to make more accurate, informed and effective choices.
informed.translationZh: 这能让你做出更准确、更明智且更有效的选择。
informed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第10句

informed.sentenceEn: Every research participant should opt in or out of receiving results, as part of the process of giving informed consent.
informed.translationZh: 每位研究参与者都应当选择是否接收研究结果，这应作为知情同意过程的一部分。
informed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第2句

informed.sentenceEn: "We teach algebra because it's important and we should teach foreign language and coding for the same reason. Exposure to a wide breadth of subjects and material results in well-rounded students who are able to make informed decisions … about what they want to pursue."
informed.translationZh: 我们教授代数是因为它很重要，而我们教授外语和编程也应出于同样的原因。广泛接触各类学科和知识能够培养出全面发展的学生，使他们能够就自己想要追求的方向做出明智的决定。

informed.sentenceEn: They also felt less informed about science and less qualified to discuss science topics.
informed.translationZh: 他们还感觉自己对科学知识的了解更少，也不太有资格讨论科学话题。
informed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

informed.sentenceEn: The public must be able to understand the basics of science to make informed decisions.
informed.translationZh: 公众必须能够理解科学基础知识，才能做出明智的决策。
informed.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

informed.sentenceEn: Make informed use of animal models.

instrumental.sentenceEn: Background speech had the biggest negative effect; vocal music was slightly more disruptive than instrumental ; and general background noise and silence were least disruptive.
instrumental.translationZh: 背景语音的负面影响最大；人声音乐比器乐音乐的干扰性略强；而一般背景噪音和安静环境的干扰性最小。
instrumental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

instrumental.sentenceEn: A group of American researchers compared students' comprehension of verbal material when reading in the presence of background speech, instrumental music or general noise.
instrumental.translationZh: 一组美国研究人员比较了学生在有背景言语、器乐或一般噪音的环境中阅读时对语言材料的理解能力。
instrumental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

instrumental.sentenceEn: Instrumental music will have at worst a slight effect.
instrumental.translationZh: 器乐音乐最坏情况下也只会产生轻微影响。
instrumental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

instrumental.sentenceEn: So when children are reading and trying to incorporate new material, parents could consider allowing some background music, particularly if it's instrumental and their child is the outgoing type.
instrumental.translationZh: 因此，当孩子阅读和学习新知识时，家长可以考虑允许播放一些背景音乐，尤其是当音乐为纯器乐演奏且孩子性格外向时。
instrumental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

instrumental.sentenceEn: British researchers compared the effects of background speech, vocal music, instrumental music, general background noise and silence on short-term memory.
instrumental.translationZh: 英国研究人员比较了背景言语、有声音乐、器乐、一般背景噪音和安静环境对短期记忆的影响。
instrumental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

insufficient.sentenceEn: Stop and go were insufficient for the new volumes of cars zooming through intersections.
insufficient.translationZh: 面对在交叉路口疾驰而过的庞大车流，原有的启停控制方式已显得捉襟见肘。

insufficient.sentenceEn: "Since our bodies are essentially made anew every few weeks, the material in them alone is clearly insufficient to explain the persistent thread of an identity."
insufficient.translationZh: 既然我们的身体每隔几周就基本上会更新一次，那么显然仅凭体内的物质不足以解释身份认同这一持续存在的脉络。
insufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

insufficient.sentenceEn: Social and environmental activists, scientists and indigenous groups have called the Paris Agreement of the United Nations Climate Change Conference in December 2015 insufficient , weak, or compromised.
insufficient.translationZh: 社会与环境活动家、科学家以及原住民群体认为，2015年12月联合国气候变化大会达成的《巴黎协定》不够充分、力度不足或是已有所妥协。

insufficient.sentenceEn: And working alone, there have been times when I've found that money alone provides insufficient motivation.
insufficient.translationZh: 而且独自工作时，我发现有时单靠金钱是不足以激励人的。
insufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

insufficient.sentenceEn: Perhaps worse, the detrimental effects of an unhealthy diet and insufficient exercise are not limited to your body.
insufficient.translationZh: 或许更糟糕的是，不健康饮食和运动不足的有害影响并不局限于身体层面。
insufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

insufficient.sentenceEn: The expert review also found insufficient evidence to recommend any drugs or dietary supplements that could prevent or slow cognitive decline.
insufficient.translationZh: 专家评审还发现，没有足够证据推荐任何能够预防或减缓认知衰退的药物或膳食补充剂。
insufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

intake.sentenceEn: Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods.
intake.translationZh: 研究人员回顾了所有已发表的与饮食多样性相关的证据，发现饮食多样性与健康食品和不健康食品摄入量的增加均存在相关性。
intake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

intake.sentenceEn: When there was a great deal of food available, ancient people would gorge on calories; this massive calorie intake was accompanied by an urge to get active.
intake.translationZh: 当食物供应充足时，古人会大量摄入卡路里；这种大量的卡路里摄入会伴随着活动的冲动。
intake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

intake.sentenceEn: So this shows negative consequences of poor dietary intake can occur even when body weight has not changed conspicuously.
intake.translationZh: 因此这表明，即使体重没有明显变化，不良饮食所带来的负面影响也可能已经产生。
intake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

intake.sentenceEn: Pipitone says if you increase protein, you also have to increase your fluid intake .
intake.translationZh: 皮普itone表示，如果你增加蛋白质摄入量，就必须同时增加液体摄入量。

intake.sentenceEn: It has, however, different patterns of fat intake .
intake.translationZh: 然而，地中海饮食的脂肪摄入模式有所不同。
intake.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

intake.sentenceEn: People should limit calorie intake to avoid obesity.
intake.translationZh: 人们应该限制卡路里摄入以避免肥胖。

intention.sentenceEn: Look, all I'm going to say is that it was never my intention to offend anyone.
intention.translationZh: 听着，我想说的是，我从来没有冒犯任何人的意思。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

intention.sentenceEn: I hear devoted, loving mothers say that when they are through raising their children, they have no intention of becoming grandmothers.
intention.translationZh: 我听到一些尽心尽力、充满爱心的母亲说，等她们把孩子抚养成人后，根本不想当祖母。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

intention.sentenceEn: EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to "spark conversations" among all Indian stakeholders.
intention.translationZh: EAT-柳叶刀委员会声称其意图是在印度所有利益相关者中“引发对话”。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

intention.sentenceEn: In an era when you can simply buy a CubeSat kit off the shelf, how can we trust the satellites over our heads were developed with good intentions by people who knew what they were doing?
intention.translationZh: 在如今这个时代，任何人都能轻松购买到现成的立方体卫星套件，我们如何能相信头顶上这些卫星是由懂行的人怀着善意开发的呢？

intention.sentenceEn: Most Grand Tourists, however, stayed for briefer periods and set out with less scholarly intentions , accompanied by a teacher or guardian, and expected to return home with souvenirs of their travels as well as an understanding of art and architecture formed by exposure to great masterpieces.
intention.translationZh: 然而，大多数壮游者的行程较短，旅行目的也不那么学术。他们通常在教师或监护人的陪同下出行，期望回国时不仅带回旅行纪念品，还能通过接触伟大杰作形成对艺术和建筑的理解。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

intention.sentenceEn: The Department of Health declared its intention to consider the move in November 2010 and consulted through 2012.
intention.translationZh: 卫生部于2010年11月宣布有意考虑这一举措，并在2012年期间进行了咨询。
intention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

interracial.sentenceEn: "At Indiana University, where housing was not so tight, more interracial roommates split up," he said.
interracial.translationZh: 他说：“印第安纳大学的住房不像这里那么紧张，不同种族的室友组合分开的比例更高。”
interracial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

interracial.sentenceEn: Because interracial roommate relationships are often problematic, Dr. Fazio said, many students would like to move out, but university housing policies may make it hard to leave.
interracial.translationZh: 法齐奥博士表示，由于跨种族室友关系往往存在问题，许多学生都想搬出去，但大学的住宿政策可能会让他们难以如愿。
interracial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

interracial.sentenceEn: Russell Fazio, an Ohio State psychology professor who has studied interracial roommates there and at Indiana University, discovered an intriguing academic effect.
interracial.translationZh: 罗素·法齐奥是俄亥俄州立大学的心理学教授，他在该校和印第安纳大学都对跨种族室友进行过研究，发现了一个有趣的学术效应。
interracial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

interracial.sentenceEn: That same study found the randomly assigned interracial roommates at Ohio State broke up before the end of the quarter about twice as often as same-race roommates.
interracial.translationZh: 同一项研究发现，在俄亥俄州立大学，随机分配的跨种族室友在学期结束前分开的比例大约是同种族室友的两倍。
interracial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interracial.sentenceEn: Dr. Fazio's Indiana study found that three times as many randomly assigned interracial roommates were no longer living together at the end of the semester, compared with white roommates.
interracial.translationZh: 法齐奥博士在印第安纳大学的研究发现，在学期结束时，随机分配的跨种族室友不再同住的比例是白人室友的三倍。
interracial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interracial.sentenceEn: What did the study find about randomly assigned interracial roommates at Ohio State University?
interracial.translationZh: 关于俄亥俄州立大学随机分配的跨种族室友，这项研究有何发现？

invasive.sentenceEn: "You might imagine micro-robots as agents to repair or assemble small structures or machines in industry or as surgical assistants to clear clogged arteries, to stop internal bleeding, or to eliminate cancerous tumours—all in minimally invasive procedures," Rogers said.
invasive.translationZh: 罗杰斯说：“你可以将微型机器人想象成工业中用于修复或组装小型结构或机器的工具，或者是外科手术的助手，用于疏通堵塞的动脉、止血或消除癌性肿瘤——所有这些都通过微创手术完成。”
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

invasive.sentenceEn: What is more, non-native species can appear harmless for decades, then turn invasive .
invasive.translationZh: 更重要的是，非本土物种可能在数十年内看似无害，然后突然变成入侵物种。
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

invasive.sentenceEn: "Both native and exotic species can become invasive , and so they all have to be monitored and controlled when they begin to get out of hand."
invasive.translationZh: 本土物种和外来物种都可能变成入侵物种，因此当它们开始失控时，都必须加以监测和控制。
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

invasive.sentenceEn: Of the 7,000 alien species in the United States—out of a total of 150,000 species—only about 10 percent are invasive , he pointed out.
invasive.translationZh: 他指出，在美国总共15万个物种中，外来物种有7000种，其中只有约10%具有入侵性。
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

invasive.sentenceEn: Next to habitat loss, these invasive species represent the greatest threat to biodiversity worldwide, many ecologists say.
invasive.translationZh: 许多生态学家表示，除栖息地丧失外，这些入侵物种是全球生物多样性面临的最大威胁。
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

invasive.sentenceEn: The Nature Conservancy has declared war on a multitude of invasive species here, from sheep to plants to the aggressive Argentine ant.
invasive.translationZh: 大自然保护协会已对岛上多种入侵物种宣战，从绵羊到各类植物，再到极具攻击性的阿根廷蚂蚁。
invasive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

inventor.sentenceEn: In Cleveland, an African-American inventor named Garrett Morgan came up with an affordable, patented traffic signal.
inventor.translationZh: 在克利夫兰，一位名叫加勒特·摩根的非裔美国发明家构思出一种价格低廉且拥有专利的交通信号灯。

inventor.sentenceEn: Marconi may not have been the greatest inventor of his time, but more than anyone else, he brought about a fundamental shift in the way we communicate.
inventor.translationZh: 马可尼或许不是他那个时代最伟大的发明家，但他比任何人都更深刻地改变了我们的通信方式。

inventor.sentenceEn: A hundred years before iconic figures like Bill Gates and Steve Jobs permeated our lives, an Irish-Italian inventor laid the foundation of the communication explosion of the 21st century.
inventor.translationZh: 在比尔·盖茨和史蒂夫·乔布斯等标志性人物深入我们生活的一百年前，一位爱尔兰裔意大利发明家为21世纪的通信革命奠定了基础。

inventor.sentenceEn: The dream of personalised flight is still vivid in the minds of many inventors , some developing cycle-powered craft, others pouring money into jetpacks(喷气飞行背包).
inventor.translationZh: 个性化飞行的梦想在众多发明家心中依然鲜活，有人在研发人力飞行器，也有人斥资研发喷气飞行背包。
inventor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

inventor.sentenceEn: But that won't stop inventors from dreaming up new ways to fly and trying to persuade investors to back their sometimes outrageous schemes.
inventor.translationZh: 但这并不能阻止发明家们构想新的飞行方式，并试图说服投资者支持他们有时颇为离谱的计划。
inventor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

inventor.translationZh: 她是一位著名的发明家。

investigation.sentenceEn: It isn't ground-breaking to say workers feel fatigued after a meeting, but only in recent decades have scientists deemed the condition worthy of further investigation .
investigation.translationZh: 说员工开会后感到疲劳并非什么惊天动地的发现，但直到最近几十年，科学家们才认为这种情况值得进一步研究。

investigation.sentenceEn: In matters of science at least, those who value their common sense over methodological, collaborative investigation imagine themselves to be more free in their thinking, unbound by involvement with the group, but in reality they are tightly bound by their capabilities and perspectives.
investigation.translationZh: 至少在科学领域，那些重视自身常识胜过系统性协作研究的人，自认为思维更加自由，不受群体参与的束缚，然而事实上，他们却被自身的能力和视角牢牢限制。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

investigation.sentenceEn: Researchers carried out an investigation to explore the correlation between having kind thoughts and a person's psychological state.
investigation.translationZh: 研究人员开展了一项调查，旨在探索怀有善意想法与个人心理状态之间的相关性。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

investigation.sentenceEn: The action stems from a federal court order issued on Tuesday requiring Apple to help the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) to unlock an iPhone used by one of the two attackers who killed 14 people in San Bernardino, California, in December.
investigation.translationZh: 这一行动源于周二发布的一项联邦法院命令，该命令要求苹果公司协助美国联邦调查局（FBI）解锁一部iPhone，该手机的使用者是去年12月在加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺杀害14人的两名袭击者之一。

investigation.sentenceEn: The order essentially asks Apple to hack its own devices, and once it is in place, the precedent could be used to justify law enforcement efforts to get around encryption technologies in other investigations far removed from national security threats.
investigation.translationZh: 这项命令实质上是要求苹果公司入侵自己的设备，一旦实施，这一先例可能被用来为执法部门的相关行动提供正当理由——在与国家安全威胁毫无关联的其他调查中规避加密技术。

investigation.sentenceEn: It is not based on sufficient investigations into the ecological system.
investigation.translationZh: 它没有基于对生态系统的充分调查。

irrigation.sentenceEn: A World Bank irrigation project in Ethiopia helped farmers increase their potato harvest from about 8 tonnes per hectare to 35 tonnes.
irrigation.translationZh: 世界银行在埃塞俄比亚开展的一个灌溉项目帮助农民将土豆产量从约8吨/公顷提高到了35吨/公顷。

irrigation.sentenceEn: A group of corn farmers stands huddled around an agronomist(农学家) and his computer on the side of an irrigation machine in central South Africa.
irrigation.translationZh: 在南非中部，一群玉米农正簇拥在一位农学家和他的电脑旁，他们站在一台灌溉机旁边。

irrigation.sentenceEn: Most of these operations draw irrigation water from local rivers or lakes.
irrigation.translationZh: 这些农场大多从当地的河流或湖泊抽取灌溉用水。
irrigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

irrigation.sentenceEn: When this water is used for agricultural irrigation , farmers risk absorbing disease-causing bacteria, as do consumers who eat the produce raw and unwashed.
irrigation.translationZh: 当这些水用于农业灌溉时，农民面临感染致病细菌的风险，生吃和未清洗农产品的消费者也同样面临这一风险。
irrigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

irrigation.sentenceEn: In poor, dry regions, untreated wastewater is the only viable irrigation source to keep farmers in business.
irrigation.translationZh: 在贫困干旱地区，未经处理的废水是维持农民生计的唯一可行灌溉水源。
irrigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

irrigation.sentenceEn: What is the main problem caused by the use of wastewater for irrigation ?
irrigation.translationZh: 使用废水灌溉造成的主要问题是什么？

islander.sentenceEn: Because great numbers of people go there, the islanders have built elaborate resorts, developed harbors and airfields, improved the beaches and have expanded sea and air routes.
islander.translationZh: 由于大量游客前往这些岛屿，岛民们修建了豪华度假村，开发了港口和机场，改善了海滩，并拓展了海上和空中航线。
islander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

islander.sentenceEn: Islanders make the best they can of what they have.
islander.translationZh: 岛民们尽其所能地利用他们拥有的一切。
islander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第8句

islander.sentenceEn: Such schools have become a model in Hawaii, but the islanders' local language is still classed by UNESCO as critically endangered because only 1,000 people speak it.
islander.translationZh: 这类学校在夏威夷已成为典范，但由于仅1000人使用这种语言，联合国教科文组织仍将岛民的本地语言列为极度濒危语言。
islander.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

islander.sentenceEn: Women islanders usually rely on their husbands to get some medicines for them without diagnoses and prescriptions.
islander.translationZh: 岛上妇女通常依靠丈夫为她们购买一些未经诊断和开处方的药物。
